Position Summary:

The Procurement Contract Specialist serves as the operational liaison between Procurement and Legal, helping accelerate contract review, improve contract quality, and strengthen contract data governance across the enterprise. This role performs first-pass commercial and administrative review of sourcing agreements using company-approved standards and playbooks, coordinates and tracks Legal review, maintains consistent contract documentation and file naming, and captures required contract metadata in the enterprise contract repository. The Procurement Contract Specialist partners closely with Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, Legal, business stakeholders, and suppliers to improve visibility, prioritization, cycle time, and compliance throughout the contracting process. The role does not provide legal advice and escalates non-standard legal terms and risk decisions to Legal in accordance with established guidelines.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between Procurement and Legal for sourcing and supplier contract workflow, status, documentation, and prioritization.
  • Perform first-pass review of supplier agreements, statements of work, amendments, order forms, and related sourcing documents using approved Procurement and Legal contracting standards, templates, and playbooks.
  • Identify and redline approved business and commercial terms thatNeoGenomicsseeks to preserve across agreements, such as payment terms, renewal provisions, termination rights, pricing protections, service-level commitments, and other pre-approved positions.
  • Route legal issues, non-standard provisions, material deviations, and risk-based decisions to Legal for review and resolution; do not independently provide legal advice or approve legal risk.
  • Partner with Procurement to assess business urgency, sourcing stage, financial impact, and operational needin order toprioritize agreements submitted for Legal review.
  • Partner with Legal to maintain visibility to contract status, ownership, open issues, aging, next actions, and expected completion dates.
  • Maintain a centralized contract tracker and provide routine reporting on contract volume, cycle time, aging, bottlenecks, pending actions, and other workflow metrics.
  • Apply and maintain standardized contract naming conventions, version control, folder structure, and document retention methodology across Procurement-managed agreements.
  • Ensure final executed agreements, amendments, exhibits, and supporting documentation are accurately stored in the designated contract repository and linked to the appropriate supplier and sourcing record.
  • Extract, validate, and maintain required contract metadata, including supplier name, agreement type, effective date, expiration date, renewal terms, notice periods, contract value, payment terms, business owner, category, Legal owner, termination provisions, and other required data fields.
  • Monitor upcoming expirations, renewals, termination-notice dates, and other key contractual milestones and communicate required actions to Procurement and business stakeholders.
  • Support supplier and internal stakeholder follow-up related to contract comments, outstanding documentation, signatures, and next-step actions.
  • Coordinate signature-ready documentation and support handoff to the approved electronic signature process once Legal and business approvals are complete.
  • Identify recurring negotiation issues, contract exceptions, and process delays and recommend updates to playbooks, templates, intake requirements, and contracting workflows.
  • Support implementation and ongoing administration of contract lifecycle management tools, repositories, workflow automation, dashboards, and reporting capabilities.
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive commercial, legal, supplier, and company information in accordance with company policies and access requirements.

Experience, Education and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Legal Studies, Paralegal Studies, Finance, Operations, or related field preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.
  • Paralegal certificate, contract management certification, or procurement-related certification is a plus but not required.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in contract administration, contract management, procurement, strategic sourcing, legal operations, paralegal support, or a related business function.
  • Experience reviewing commercial agreements and working from approved contract templates, clause libraries, or negotiation playbooks.
  • Experience coordinating contract workflow between Procurement, Legal, business stakeholders, and external suppliers or service providers.
  • Experience managing contract repositories, document control, metadata capture, and contract status tracking.
  • Experience within healthcare, laboratory, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, or another regulated industry preferred.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management systems, e-signature platforms, Oracle Fusion Cloud, or comparable procurement/ERP systems preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent agreements, deadlines, and stakeholder priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of commercial contracting concepts and common supplier agreement structures, including master service agreements, statements of work, amendments, order forms, confidentiality agreements, and purchase-related terms.
  • Ability to review and redline agreements against company-approved business positions, templates, and playbooks while recognizing when issues require escalation to Legal.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle processes, document control, version management, metadata governance, and repository administration.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to maintain accuracy across high volumes of documents and data.
  • Strong project management and workflow coordination skills with the ability to prioritize competing requests and drive timely next actions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Legal, Procurement, business leaders, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential, commercially sensitive, or legally privileged information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; advanced Excel skills and experience with workflow, reporting, or dashboard tools preferred.
  • Ability to learn and administer contract lifecycle management, sourcing, ERP, and e-signature systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify process bottlenecks, data-quality issues, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority and maintain productive relationships across functions.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability tolift upto 15 pounds.
  • Ability to occasionally travel within company locations as needed

Description

We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Regional Sales Director to own the company's go-to-market strategy and revenue growth within a defined region.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong B2B enterprise sales experience, a solid understanding of capital markets and financial institutions, and the ability to build a market from the ground up. You will be responsible for developing relationships with banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, and other financial institutions, while building the local partnerships, processes, and team required to scale the company in the region.

We are looking for people who are highly independent, commercially driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment. You should be someone who can identify opportunities, open doors, build processes from scratch, and take ownership beyond the traditional boundaries of a sales role.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and execute the regional go-to-market strategy, including target accounts, market segmentation, competitive positioning, partnerships, and sales priorities.
  • Own regional revenue targets and take full responsibility for market growth.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle for strategic accounts, from prospecting and first meetings through negotiation and signed contracts.
  • Proactively identify and bring in new customers across banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, and other financial institutions.
  • Build sales processes, market-entry strategies, and commercial activities from scratch when entering or developing a new region.
  • Develop and manage local partnerships that support pipeline generation, market credibility, and business development.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers across financial institutions.
  • Represent the company in meetings with senior executives, commercial stakeholders, and technology teams.
  • Understand customer needs and communicate the company's offering within the context of capital markets, financial data, APIs, iframe integrations, and B2B technology solutions.
  • Work closely with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other internal teams to move opportunities forward and support customers.
  • Take ownership of opportunities and business needs even when they fall outside the traditional scope of the role.
  • Hire, coach, and manage regional sales talent as the market grows.
  • Build and maintain an active network of relevant contacts within the region.
  • Provide regular reporting on pipeline, forecasts, market developments, competitive activity, and overall regional progress to global leadership.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise, institutional, or B2B sales, ideally within Fintech, Capital Markets, Financial Data, WealthTech, or B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record of closing complex, high-value B2B deals.
  • Experience selling to or working with banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, or other financial institutions.
  • Strong understanding of the capital markets ecosystem and the ability to communicate comfortably using relevant financial and technical terminology.
  • Ability to understand and discuss technology concepts relevant to the sales process, including APIs, iframe integrations, data platforms, and B2B software integrations.
  • Strong understanding of markets, customer structures, buying processes, and commercial decision-making.
  • Existing network of relevant contacts within the target region.
  • Proven ability to build sales processes, pipelines, partnerships, and market presence from scratch.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong ability to identify opportunities and turn them into commercial results.
  • Highly autonomous and comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Willingness to take initiative and handle responsibilities outside the strict boundaries of the role when needed.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent English, with the ability to lead high-level business conversations and negotiations.
  • Fluent in the primary language of the relevant region.

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is an integral part of the Fortinet sales organization. You will collaborate with multiple Field & Inside Sales Account Managers to help drive revenue in an assigned territory. Assist in building and executing a plan to help grow the territory’s business, both in terms of new customer acquisition and growing existing customer relationships. Work closely in a team approach with Fortinet’s reseller partners, marketing and channel teams to drive deals to increase revenue. Fortinet will provide detailed and ongoing training programs to help drive your own personal success in the ISR role, as well as prepare you for multiple career path opportunities across Fortinet’s sales organization. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to begin your sales career as an ISR.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand sales cycles in conjunction with business processes internally and externally.
  • Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations and quotes in Salesforce.com)
  • Address any customer satisfaction issues / requests in a timely manner.
  • Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
  • Assist with customer presentations and demos via online tools Teams/Zoom
  • Align with sales, channel and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets.
  • Perform other duties and projects, as assigned, to support the growth or our business.
  • Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience
  • Coachable and flexible.
  • Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high-volume workload; Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
  • Be computer savvy.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Well organized with effective time and activity management skills.
  • Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) or in a similar role preferred.
  • Experience in cybersecurity or a related industry is a plus.
  • Experience with Salesforce a plus.
  • Experience with multi-tier distribution a plus.
  • Experience in networking, security and/or public/private cloud a plus.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

On-target earnings (OTE) for this full-time position is expected to be between $80,000 - $98,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

title: UI/UX Designer (f/m/d) - Remote in Germany
description: Hundreds of engineering tools.  One platform to connect them to AI agents.

raw.title: UI/UX Designer (f/m/d) - Remote in Germany
raw.excerpt: Hundreds of engineering tools.  One platform to connect them to AI agents.
raw.description:
Hundreds of engineering tools. One platform to connect them to AI agents. We need the designer who can.

Integrating a couple of software tools for mechanical engineers into an AI automation platform is hard. Integrating 100+ and making them accessible to both human engineers and AI agents? That's a design challenge. We're looking for someone who can translate tool-specific complexity into visual patterns that scale, unlock complex engineering tools for AI agents to work with, and help our users automate their day-to-day in days, not months.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for an experienced UI/UX Designer to shape how engineers interact with complex simulation and analysis tools through our automation platform, from visual programming interfaces to AI-powered workflow building.

As part of a tightly knit product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead in our most technical product team, you'll help define how we integrate engineering tools into our platform. You'll work on translating tool-specific details into abstracted, interchangeable nodes, evolving our 3D viewer to support growing engineering domains, and designing AI-based experiences that help engineers build valuable automations in days instead of months.

At Synera, design isn't a handoff. It's a core part of how we build. You'll bring structure to technical ambiguity, collaborate closely with developers, and ensure that what we ship at lightning pace is not just functional, but truly intuitive for engineering users.

You'll do discovery, map complex and highly technical user journeys, and see the design cycle through concept to high-fidelity prototype. As one of four Synera UI/UX designers, you'll get your hands dirty: From designing individual node interfaces and creating patterns that scale across multiple engineering domains to our AI-based workflow builder that helps users translate their expertise into reliable automations.

Working closely with our users from mechanical engineering, CFD, and optimization backgrounds, you'll get firsthand feedback and real use cases to continuously refine the user experience.

If you're eager to own design at the intersection of complex engineering tools and AI automation, and have a visible impact from day one, we'd love to meet you.

👉 Your responsibilities span the full design cycle:

📣 Drive discovery & feedback loops

You engage with real users (mostly engineers from the aerospace or automotive industries) to gather insights, test assumptions, and continuously improve the experience based on real-world use. You'll learn about their engineering workflows and tool requirements to inform design decisions.

✨ UX concepts and UI design

You organize and facilitate design sessions, uncover and define user journeys for technical workflows, collaborate with the other UI/UX designers on our product's information architecture and prototype ideas in close collaboration with developers. From early concepts to polished designs: you own the experience. This includes designing node interfaces for integrated engineering tools and patterns for tool interchangeability. Oh, and did we mention icons? Lot’s of icons…

🤝 Work in the Product Trio

As part of the product trio with your Product Manager and Tech Lead you shape the product vision, gather requirements, and turn complexity into clarity. You'll translate technical tool specifications into user-friendly abstractions and be the voice of the user in a team that values engineering precision and usability equally.

⏱ Deliver Value Quickly but with Quality

As a fast-growing start-up, it's all about speed for us. You balance creativity with pragmatism to ensure high-quality designs while meeting sprint goals. We ship iteratively, and your designs will have a fast, visible impact, helping users achieve valuable automations in days versus months.

🌱 Strengthen Our Design Culture

You'll actively participate in design critiques among designers and help raise the bar across the company. We believe in growing together and maintaining a consistent, intuitive design system across the product.

⚡In the first 6 months: You start to take ownership of the design for engineering integration projects, developing new building blocks for our automation platform.

⚡By 12 months: You will have design ownership of the mechanical engineering capabilities of our platform, working on abstraction of complex workflows as well as expanding our platforms features as we approach new domains like fluid dynamics or electrical engineering.

Find the other designers of Synera on the photo and join our next company event to connect, relax, and have fun together with other Synerians!

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary range is:

  • Intermediate Level: 50,800-67,200 EUR

  • Experienced Level: 65,500-84,100 EUR

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You actively contribute to shaping our products' look and feel as part of a multidisciplinary product team.

  • You see the impact of your work in every 4-month release.

  • You evaluate your designs with users from high-profile customers like BMW, NASA or Miele.

  • Enjoy true flexibility: work when and where it suits you, and swap public holidays to match your own values and beliefs (as long as you have residency in Germany).

  • Get home-office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Use your personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regional meet-ups, weekly virtual coffee breaks, and workshops. Plus, we come together as a whole company for our annual Summer Event! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have 4+ years of hands-on UI/UX design experience designing products in the mechanical engineering space.

  • You have a good understanding of engineering processes, specifically simulations like FEA or CFD.

  • You have experience with 3D interfaces or visualization tools.

  • You have a proven track record of end-to-end design ownership, from discovery research through shipped product.

  • You have strong visual design skills: You have a sharp eye for layout, typography, color, and can demonstrate polished UI work in your portfolio.

  • You have Figma proficiency at a level where you're pushing the tool's limits, not learning basics.

  • You have experience working in product trios or closely embedded with PMs and engineers in agile/iterative environments.

  • You can manage ambiguity: You've worked in early-stage products, pivots, or fast-moving teams where you had to define the path forward.

  • Your super English skills help you to work in an international environment.

    Bonus points - cherry on top 🍰

  • You're familiar with complex design systems or component libraries.

  • You have a background in visual programming tools, no-code/low-code platforms, or workflow automation.

  • You have an understanding of AI/ML product patterns (agentic systems, prompt interfaces, etc.).

  • You are based in Bremen or open to relocating. We do offer remote working within Germany; however, for key roles like UX, we’ve found that close in-person collaboration works best.

Synera is a place where everyone can grow and every voice is valued. So, however you identify yourself and whatever background you have, if this role excites you, please apply with your English CV (no photo and birth date needed :)) and portfolio. Tell us how your unique perspective will benefit our Design team.

Why Synera?

Synera is an AI automation platform for engineers that drastically accelerates product development, as proven by numerous customers in the automotive, aerospace and consumer goods industries such as Airbus, BMW, EDAG and Miele. We achieve this by integrating engineering tools, data, and expert knowledge into a low-code environment that helps engineers create digital coworkers and automate complex processes.

We change the way product development works and are looking for a UX Designer (f/m/d). Do you want to join?

raw.description:
Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack, com paixão por tecnologia, produto e experiência do usuário. Se você se considera uma pessoa talentosa em desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na jornada e no engajamento dos usuários e tem interesse em atuar em iniciativas que contribuem diretamente para a retenção e expansão dos nossos clientes, essa é a sua chance!

Você fará parte do time de Retenção, dentro da nossa vertical de Growth, responsável por criar soluções e iniciativas que melhoram a experiência dos nossos usuários e contribuem para que nossos clientes permaneçam ativos e engajados na nossa base, atuando de forma colaborativa e remota com os times de tecnologia, produto e marketing.

  • Experimentação e CRO:Construir lógica de servidor e front-end para suportar testes A/B,feature flagse experimentos de otimização de conversão.
  • Integrações:Conectar nossa plataforma a ferramentas essenciais de crescimento, como CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce), gateways de pagamento (Stripe), automação de marketing e ferramentas de análise (Segment, Mixpanel).
  • Performance e SEO:Garantir a máxima velocidade de carregamento (Core Web Vitals) e aplicar boas práticas de SEO técnico para impulsionar a aquisição orgânica.
  • Arquitetura e Qualidade:Escrever código limpo, semântico e coberto por testes automatizados, garantindo uma arquitetura segura e resiliente para picos de acesso.
  • Cultura de Dados:Colaborar com o time de dados para segmentar usuários e instrumentar o front-end para capturar métricas de interação (GA4, Mixpanel).
  • Experiência Fullstack:Sólida vivência no desenvolvimento de aplicações web de alta disponibilidade.
  • Back-end:Domínio deRuby on Railse desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful robustas.
  • Front-end:Proficiência em(ou ), TypeScript, HTML5 semântico e CSS3 (Tailwind CSS).
  • Arquitetura:Conhecimento em microsserviços e sistemas de mensageria (Sidekiq, SQS, Kafka).
  • Bancos de Dados:Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e experiência com bancos não-relacionais, como DynamoDB.
  • Integrações:Experiência prática com APIs de terceiros (pagamentos, marketing e vendas).
  • Testes:Vivência com testes automatizados (RSpec para back-end; Jest/Cypress para front-end).
  • DevOps Básico:Familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de nuvem (AWS).
  • Mentalidade Growth:Orientação a dados e entendimento de métricas como taxa de conversão, CAC e ativação.

Diferencial:

  • Linguagens:Conhecimento emGolang.
  • Experiência em Growth:Vivência prévia em times de Growth ou estratégias deProduct-Led Growth(PLG).
  • Sistemas Financeiros:Experiência com gestão de assinaturas e faturamento (Stripe Billing, Chargebee).
  • Modelagem de Arquitetura:Capacidade de documentar e comunicar soluções técnicas através deDiagramas C4, diagramas de eventos e sequência.
  • Dados:Conhecimento sobredata pipelinese ferramentas de ETL.
  • Acessibilidade:Práticas de acessibilidade web (WCAG).

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

raw.title: Director of Finance, EMEA
raw.excerpt: The Director of Finance, EMEA provides regional finance leadership and business partnership across EMEA.
raw.description:
The Director of Finance, EMEA provides regional finance leadership and business partnership across EMEA. The role owns regional financial reporting, planning, compliance and controls, partnering with the CFO, regional business leaders and global finance teams to drive strong financial performance, informed decision-making and appropriate governance across the region.
This is a Senior Leadership Team role in EMEA, operating within a broader global finance model. Core finance activities such as accounting, treasury, billing, FP&A, legal, international, tax and other specialist areas are delivered in partnership with global shared-service and specialist teams. The Director retains clear regional ownership for financial reporting, planning, compliance and controls while drawing on those global capabilities for successful delivery.
The position provides commercial insight and accountable regional finance leadership across EMEA, ensuring financial information is accurate, timely and understood, risks are actively managed, and finance processes remain practical, scalable and aligned with SANS's operating model.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Finance Leadership
  • Partner with the CFO and regional leaders to provide financial insight, challenge and recommendations that support business decisions and the evaluation of opportunities across EMEA.
  • Provide financial leadership for regional growth initiatives, business planning and key projects in partnership with global finance and other shared teams.
  • Promote financial accountability and commercial awareness across the region.

Financial Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting
  • Own regional budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities for EMEA, partnering with regional stakeholders and the global FP&A team to ensure robust and aligned plans.
  • Own the regional view of financial performance, trends, risks and opportunities, providing clear analysis and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Ensure regional leaders receive clear, timely and useful financial information to support effective decision-making.

Financial Reporting and Accounting
  • Own the quality, timeliness and relevance of regional financial reporting and review regional financial statements and reporting outputs.
  • Partner with the central Accounting and Finance teams to ensure regional reporting requirements are understood, delivered and appropriately governed.
Statutory, Tax and Regulatory Compliance
  • Own regional oversight of statutory, tax and regulatory compliance matters, partnering with global finance, legal, international, tax and external advisors as appropriate.
  • Identify, manage and, where specialist input is required, escalate regional compliance or entity-related matters in a timely manner.
  • Maintain appropriate knowledge of relevant local requirements and ensure they are reflected in informed business and finance decisions across EMEA.

Internal Controls, Governance and Risk Management
  • Own and maintain appropriate regional financial governance, internal controls and risk management in line with company policies and global finance processes.
  • Partner with shared teams to identify, assess and address regional financial, operational and compliance risks.

Finance Operations and Business Support
  • Act as the senior regional finance partner and accountable escalation point for operational matters requiring finance leadership or input.
  • Partner with shared Accounting, Billing, Treasury, FP&A, International and other teams to ensure practical, efficient and scalable regional finance processes.

Finance and Business Process Transformation and Continuous Improvement
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that make regional finance and broader business processes and ways of working more effective and scalable.
  • Support the future migration from Microsoft Dynamics SL to an updated ERP platform, representing EMEA requirements and helping ensure effective regional adoption and implementation.
Leadership and Team Development
  • Lead and develop the regional finance team, shaping the future regional finance structure and capability.
  • Build strong collaboration and clear accountability across regional finance, global finance and business partners.
Stakeholder Management
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with regional leaders, global finance colleagues, shared functional teams and external advisors.
  • Serve as the principal regional finance interface between EMEA operations and the global finance organisation, ensuring regional priorities and global finance requirements are effectively aligned.
  • Manage priorities effectively within the direct reporting relationship to the CFO and dotted-line relationship to the Managing Director, EMEA, balancing regional and global requirements constructively.
  • Communicate financial information, business updates and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

Other
  • Carry out such other duties as may reasonably be required to support the needs of the business and responsibilities of the role.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Graduate and professionally qualified management accountant CIMA or Dutch equivalent).
  • Proven experience overseeing finance operations across multiple EMEA legal entities and jurisdictions, including financial governance, payroll compliance, supplier management, financial reporting and adherence to local statutory and regulatory requirements.
  • Significant proven experience reviewing financial performance, management reporting and key business metrics, providing financial insight and ensuring the delivery of accurate management information to support business decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide financial analysis, challenge and assurance to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting the establishment and ongoing management of legal entities across Europe, including associated financial, tax, payroll and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience working within a global finance environment, partnering with international stakeholders and supporting financial activities across multiple regions and legal entities.
  • Demonstrated experience operating within a global, matrixed organisation, building effective relationships and influencing stakeholders across multiple regions and functions.
  • Strong understanding of VAT compliance and financial control processes across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions.
  • Strong understanding of international tax requirements, including corporation tax, VAT and transfer pricing within a multi-jurisdictional environment.
  • Strong understanding of financial systems, reporting tools and financial reporting processes within a multi-entity, international environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
  • Experience leading, managing and developing finance professionals, including performance management, coaching and capability development.
  • Experience building and leading high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to work effectively across functions, countries and regions.
  • Exceptional organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines whilst maintaining high standards of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a commercial mindset and the ability to translate financial information into meaningful business insight.
  • Proactive, adaptable and solutions-oriented, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
  • Experience handling confidential and sensitive financial information with discretion and integrity.
  • Strong understanding of international payroll processes and associated compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities.
  • Understanding of multi-currency reporting, cash flow management and the financial implications of operating across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Personally aligned with SANS' mission, values and commitment to excellence.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required to support business needs.

raw.description:
Narvar is growing! We are looking for Senior Fullstack Software Engineers that enjoy working on both APIs and UIs. In this role, you will build products that power the post-purchase experience for the biggest brands in the retail industry. As a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, you will have a direct impact on our customer-facing products and work with modern technologies like Java, NodeJS, Python, React, and GraphQL to ship complex features that drive millions of views.

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.

Day-to-day

Frontend Development (Primary Focus)

  • Implement new product features & support/ extend existing ones
  • Build frontend platform components leveraged across our internal, external products and ecommerce storefronts like Shopify, Salesforce etc
  • Contribute to our overall architecture and maintain code quality standards by partnering with other senior engineers
  • Work with product and design teams to translate wireframes and mockups into functional UI components

Backend Development (Secondary Focus)

  • Contribute to development and maintenance of backend services using Golang, Node.js
  • Understanding of google cloud platform (GCP) , CI/CD and be able to deploy code and infrastructure components
  • Work with databases like postgres, spanner, bigquery
  • Understand and implement RESTful or GraphQL APIs

What we're looking for

  • You have a BS/MS in computer science, information systems, or equivalent
  • You have 10+ years of experience building reliable, scalable, and high-quality systems
  • Experience in building consumer facing applications with a frontend framework(s), such as React (preferable), Svelte Angular, Vue or Ember
  • Experience building well-designed software with NodeJS or Golang
  • Experience developing consumer facing applications consuming various APIs from a microservice backend system
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
  • Knowledge of full development life cycle and computer science fundamentals
  • Strong focus on code quality and code reviews
  • Experience with mentoring other engineers
  • Previous startup experience strongly preferred with growth and product engineering mindset

Why Narvar?

We're on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That's why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you've ever bought something online, there's a good chance you've used our platform!

From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages.

Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We're a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door. We work hard but we always make time to celebrate professional wins, baby showers, birthday parties, and everything in between.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
raw.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Senior Partner Sales Engineer

Public Sector and U.S. South | Partner-led Alteryx One outcomes

The opportunity

Data, automation and AI are reshaping how work gets done. Alteryx One brings data, analytics and AI together in a governed, accessible platform, enabling organizations to turn trusted workflows and business logic into repeatable, agent-driven outcomes.

The Senior Partner Sales Engineer is the technical and strategic lead for a focused portfolio of partners and partner-led opportunities. You will help global and regional systems integrators, solution providers, distributors and technology partners position, architect, prove, deliver and scale Alteryx One solutions. You will work across partner leadership, partner architects, Alteryx account teams, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to convert ecosystem potential into measurable customer outcomes.

This role has a specific mandate across Public Sector and the U.S. South. sales segment. It combines partner practice development with hands-on presales execution, including public sector account planning, mission-oriented use cases, secure hybrid architectures, technical evaluations and production adoption.

What success looks like

  • Priority partners can independently qualify, position, demonstrate, architect and deliver Alteryx One solutions.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities advance through stronger discovery, technical validation and executive alignment.

  • Proofs of concept and Partner Acceleration Program investments start with a named customer, measurable outcome, delivery capacity and path to production.

  • Joint solutions become reusable offerings, reference architectures, demos and managed service patterns that partners can take to additional accounts.

  • Public Sector customers receive architectures and value cases aligned to mission outcomes, security, governance, auditability and responsible AI.

  • Technical outcomes are evidenced through milestones, technical win rate, POC-to-production conversion, active usage, partner readiness and contribution to pipeline, renewal and expansion.

What you will do

Own partner technical strategy and practice development | approx. 20%

  • Build technical account plans for assigned partners, aligned to their GTM priorities, industry strengths, delivery capacity, target accounts and services economics.

  • Establish trusted-advisor relationships with partner executives, practice leaders, solution architects and sales engineers.

  • Segment partners by readiness and potential, then focus investment on those able to sell, build, support and scale repeatable customer outcomes.

  • Align with Partner Alliance Managers and field leadership on joint priorities, coverage, account mapping and measurable success criteria.

Architect differentiated Alteryx One solutions | approx. 25%

  • Lead discovery and architecture workshops that connect business outcomes to AI-ready data, analytics, automation, governance and deployment requirements.

  • Design secure cloud, hybrid and on-premises patterns across Alteryx One, modern data platforms and enterprise applications.

  • Position governed business logic as the foundation for reliable agentic outcomes, with workflows that are visible, understandable, repeatable and auditable.

  • Guide partners on Agent Studio, Alteryx MCP Server, AI Tool Palette, Ask Alteryx, Live Query, Workspace Execution and relevant Designer capabilities, distinguishing released functionality from preview or roadmap items.

  • Develop joint architectures and integration patterns with Snowflake, Databricks, Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft and other strategic technologies without displacing partner or platform-native services.

Lead partner-led technical sales and proof execution | approx. 20%

  • Support qualified partner-led opportunities from discovery through technical close, including demonstrations, whiteboarding, solution design, objection handling, security review and executive presentations.

  • Structure POCs and Partner Acceleration Program engagements around a named sponsor, funded problem, baseline, acceptance criteria, partner capacity, production owner and repeatable 5-to-10-account thesis.

  • Drive clear qualify, design, prove and produce gates. Stop or reset activity when customer demand, product fit, security, partner economics, delivery ownership or production criteria are not credible.

  • Capture reusable evidence, including reference designs, demo assets, customer proof, lessons learned and delivery handoffs.

Advance Public Sector outcomes | approx. 15%

  • Partner with Public Sector AEs, alliance leaders and delivery partners to identify mission-critical workflows in cross-government operations, defense and intelligence, public health, finance and revenue, infrastructure, transportation, human services and public safety.

  • Translate agency priorities into measurable outcomes such as improved service delivery, stronger forecasting, resource optimization, faster disaster response, better data quality and auditable decision processes.

  • Address public sector requirements for secure data access, hybrid deployment, governance, lineage, regulatory compliance, accessibility and responsible AI in coordination with Alteryx specialists.

  • Support partner-led account planning, capture activity and technical responses for relevant procurement motions. Never overstate certifications, authorizations, product availability or customer evidence.

Enable partners to operate independently | approx. 10%

  • Create role-based enablement for partner sellers, presales teams, architects and delivery consultants, combining messaging, discovery, demos, architecture and implementation readiness.

  • Coach partner technical teams through hands-on builds, certification pathways, technical win plans and delivery quality reviews.

  • Build scalable assets such as demo environments, solution blueprints, reusable workflows, industry playbooks, competitive guidance and facilitator kits.

  • Measure enablement by observed capability and customer execution, not attendance or activity volume alone.

Represent the partner and operate with discipline | approx. 10%

  • Bring structured partner and customer feedback to Product and Engineering, influence priorities with evidence and close the loop with the ecosystem.

  • Maintain current knowledge of Alteryx One, data and AI market trends, competitors, partner roadmaps, security practices and commercial dependencies.

  • Track technical milestones, partner readiness, risks, outcomes and attribution in the relevant operating systems; provide concise MBR and QBR insight.

  • Represent Alteryx at partner events, executive briefings, technical communities and customer forums.

What we are looking for

Required experience and capability

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in enterprise presales, solution engineering, solution architecture or technical consulting across data, analytics, automation, AI or adjacent enterprise software.

  • At least 3 years working directly with partner ecosystems, including GSIs, regional SIs, solution providers, distributors, ISVs or hyperscalers.

  • Demonstrated success building partner technical capability and supporting partner-sourced or partner-led enterprise opportunities through technical close.

  • Hands-on ability to lead discovery, design architectures, build compelling demonstrations and define outcome-based POCs.

  • Working knowledge of data preparation, analytics, workflow automation, governance, AI/ML and agentic AI concepts, including APIs, OAuth, MCP, LLM integration and human oversight.

  • Experience with public cloud and modern data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake or Databricks, plus hybrid and on-premises integration patterns.

  • Practical proficiency with SQL and at least one relevant analytics or programming environment such as Alteryx, Python or R.

  • Executive presence and the ability to translate technical complexity into business, partner and mission outcomes for CxO, architecture, security, data and line-of-business audiences.

  • Strong commercial judgment, prioritization and written communication; willing to challenge weak qualification and ungrounded roadmap assumptions.

  • Ability to travel up to 40%, based on territory and business needs.

Preferred and differentiating experience

  • Experience supporting U.S. Public Sector agencies and the partner ecosystem that serves them, including mission, procurement, security and delivery stakeholders.

  • Alteryx experience or certification, with the ability to ramp rapidly across Alteryx One, Designer and cloud modules.

  • Applied experience with GenAI or agentic architectures, including RAG, MCP-based tool use, prompt and context design, evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.

  • Experience creating partner practices, packaged offerings, reference architectures, marketplace propositions or managed services.

  • Cloud, data platform, architecture, security or AI certifications relevant to the territory and partner portfolio.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

How performance will be measured

Goals will be set by territory and partner portfolio. The role will be assessed on verified outcomes, not raw activity counts.

Commercial contribution

Partner-sourced and influenced pipeline progression; technical win rate; renewal and expansion influence; marketplace or consumption impact where applicable.

Partner capability

Partners independently qualifying, demoing, architecting and delivering; readiness progression; quality of partner technical plans.

Proof to production

POC-to-production conversion; time to agreed technical decision; adoption owner and support handoff; active usage and customer evidence.

Reusable scale

Validated solutions, accelerators, reference architectures and 5-to-10-account activation plans adopted by partner teams.

Execution quality

HLD and technical close plan quality; risk and milestone hygiene; accurate product positioning; Product and Engineering feedback closure.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $112,945–$123,879 with an On-Target Earnings (OTE) range of $161,350–$176,970..

In addition to base pay and commission eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

  • A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses

  • An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off

  • Mental health support and wellness reimbursement

  • Career development and education assistance


Why Alteryx

At Alteryx, you will help partners and customers move from fragmented data work and AI experimentation to governed, production-scale outcomes. You will work at the intersection of business teams, IT, data platforms and AI ecosystems, turning trusted analytic workflows into systems that drive consistent decisions and action.

We value problem solvers, innovators and high performers who challenge the status quo, keep their commitments and help the whole team succeed. Candidates who meet many, but not every, requirement are encouraged to apply. Alteryx is committed to building an inclusive workplace with a wide range of backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Alteryx will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

raw.excerpt: Who we areAt Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

Who we need

Reporting to the Manager of Practicum Applications, we are hiring a Practicum Advisor to support students in the Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology program as they prepare for practicum. As our new Practicum Advisor, you will guide students through pre-practicum requirements, helping them understand what they need to complete and supporting their progression through each stage of the process. You will review applications and documentation, track student progress, and collaborate with university teams to help ensure students are prepared to move forward with their placements in accordance with university requirements.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada.

What's in it for you

Impact on a critical stage of the student journey. Practicum is an important milestone for Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they move from academic learning toward applied professional experience. You will help students navigate the requirements leading up to this stage, providing the clarity, guidance, and follow-through they need to feel prepared and confident as they progress toward practicum.

Influence on student readiness and progression. You will play an important role in helping students successfully move through the pre-practicum process. By reviewing applications and documentation, clarifying requirements, tracking progress, and coordinating with students, potential supervisors, practicum sites, faculty, and university teams, you will help identify and resolve issues that could otherwise delay a student's progression. Your work will contribute to a well-coordinated experience and help ensure students are ready to move forward with their placements.

Specialized knowledge and career growth. You will build expertise in practicum processes, graduate education, student advising, and the requirements involved in preparing counselling psychology students for field training. Working across student services, faculty, practicum sites, and supervisors will give you broad exposure to the academic and administrative processes behind experiential learning while strengthening skills you can continue to build on within student services and post-secondary education.

How you will make an impact

  • Guide students through the pre-practicum process. You will provide clear, responsive support to Master of Arts in Counselling Psychology students as they prepare for practicum. You will answer questions, clarify requirements, and provide direction on the documentation and steps students need to complete.
  • Review and coordinate practicum applications. You will review practicum applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy, following established university requirements and processes. You will communicate with students when additional information or action is needed and help keep applications moving forward.
  • Track student progress. You will monitor students as they move through the different stages of the pre-practicum process, maintaining accurate and confidential electronic records. You will manage a high volume of information and follow up on outstanding requirements to help students stay on track.
  • Communicate and collaborate. You will correspond with students and work with practicum sites, potential supervisors, faculty, and university colleagues to support a well-coordinated practicum process. You will communicate professionally and thoughtfully, helping ensure everyone has the information they need.
  • Support continuous improvement. You will help maintain and update pre-practicum documents, resources, and presentations as requirements and processes evolve. You will contribute to the day-to-day effectiveness of the team and take on additional activities that support students and the practicum application process.

What you bring

  • The education. You have a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field, providing you with a strong foundation for understanding and supporting the needs of a diverse graduate student population.
  • The organizational skills. You are highly organized and comfortable managing a large volume of detailed and confidential information. You can work independently, prioritize competing needs, maintain accurate records, and contribute as a collaborative member of a team.
  • The technical skills. You are proficient with Microsoft Office, Adobe, and data management tools, and you are comfortable learning new systems and software. You can use technology effectively to organize information, maintain documentation, and support day-to-day processes.
  • The communication and relationship-building skills. You can build trusting relationships and communicate professionally with graduate students, prospective students, faculty, university staff, and other professionals. You know how to adapt your communication to different audiences, provide clear information, and navigate challenging conversations with diplomacy and sound judgment.
  • The ability to navigate complex situations. You bring strong conflict resolution and crisis management skills and can remain thoughtful and professional when situations are sensitive or challenging. You approach barriers with empathy, cultural sensitivity, and an understanding of the diverse experiences and needs of graduate students.

Why work at Yorkville University?

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising students, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on students, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their possible, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

Compensation philosophy

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $50,000, a midpoint of $53,500 and a maximum of $55,000. Established hires typically start near the midpoint, while the upper range is reserved for those with deep expertise and sustained contributions. Offers below the midpoint recognize strong potential with room to grow.

We strive for equitable, consistent pay, though rates may vary within the same role based on performance, specialized knowledge, and impact.

Base salary is one part of a broader package that includes paid time away, retirement savings matching, and extended health coverage with 80% of premiums paid. After 12 months of full-time employment, there is also tuition-free access to all our education programs.

We welcome conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

Join us

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

What you can expect from our hiring process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Yorkville University and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Manager of Practicum Applications and Team Lead, Practicum Applications to discuss your experience and approach to supporting students, managing detailed administrative processes, and collaborating as part of a team.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion are critical components of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Yorkville University is committed to providing accessible employment practices that comply with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation for disability, please notify Human Resources at 1-877-429-4029.

DescriptionJoin Intellect and help shape the future of workplace mental health in Australia

Intellect is a modern mental health company on a mission to make high quality mental healthcare more accessible, effective, and measurable.

We partner with organisations to deliver evidence based mental health support, and we are helping redefine workplace mental health in Australia through strong clinical governance, psychosocial risk capability, and outcomes focused care.

We are now hiring a CISP - Required, (AHPRA - preferred but not mandatory) registered Clinical Psychologist for a full time, freelance remote role based in Kalgoorlie-Boulder .

This is a unique opportunity for a psychologist who wants more than a traditional therapy role. You will combine direct clinical care with workplace assessments, psychosocial risk work, stakeholder partnership, crisis response support, and research collaboration.

You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals. This is delivered primarily through scheduled 60-minute video sessions on our platform.

This is a freelance remote role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Local candidates are preferred but others can still be considered. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.


Why join Intellect

  • Full time, remote, freelance role based in Kalgoorlie-Boulder
  • Varied scope across therapy, assessments, workplace mental health, and crisis support
  • Clinical supervision provided
  • Admin support provided
  • No need to build your own referral pipeline
  • Be part of the broader Clinical team, in a role with both direct client impact and systems level influence
  • Join a clinically led team focused on quality, governance, and measurable outcomes

About The RoleThis role is ideal for a clinician who:

  • enjoys variety in their work
  • wants to apply their skills beyond a therapy room only
  • is confident engaging both clients and non clinical stakeholders
  • is motivated by evidence based practice and systems level impact

Team and supportYou will be part of Intellect's broader Clinical team, working in a collaborative environment with clinical, operational, and cross functional partners.

This role is designed to support high quality clinical work, with supervision, CPD support, and admin support in place, so psychologists can focus on care quality and impact.

You will play an important role in delivering high quality care, supporting workplace mental health initiatives, and helping build Intellect's clinical and research presence in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Care and Psychological Assessments

  • Provide evidence based psychological therapy, both in person and virtually, in line with AHPRA requirements and Intellect clinical governance standards
  • Maintain a hands on clinical caseload with a focus on high quality, outcomes oriented care
  • Conduct psychological and workplace related assessments, including return to work assessments and other psychosocial or functional assessments
  • Provide case management and care coordination where required, including risk monitoring and escalation

Workplace Mental Health and Psychosocial Risk

  • Contribute to psychosocial risk assessments and workplace mental health initiatives across client organisations
  • Support the development of clinically sound recommendations and reports
  • Translate clinical insights into practical guidance for internal teams and client stakeholders

Stakeholder partnership and Clinical Account Support

  • Liaise with client representatives and internal stakeholders to uphold clinical quality, service standards, and reporting integrity
  • Act as a trusted clinical voice in programme discussions, helping ensure delivery remains evidence based, safe, and fit for purpose

Crisis and Critical Incident Support

  • Support on site crisis response deployments when required, including psychological first aid, group briefings, and individual stabilisation sessions
  • Ensure clear follow up pathways, continuity of care, and appropriate escalation after critical incidents

Research and Evidence Generation

  • Contribute to Intellect's research and evaluation efforts in Australia, including partnerships with universities and applied workplace mental health studies
  • Support clinically grounded data collection, interpretation, and programme improvement initiatives
  • Help strengthen Intellect's evidence base and thought leadership in workplace mental health and psychosocial safety

Requirements

    • Requirements
      • CISP - Required, (AHPRA - preferred but not mandatory) registered Clinical Psychologist
      • Master's or Doctoral qualification in Clinical Psychology
      • Minimum 3 years of clinical experience in psychological therapy and assessment
      • Experience in case management and workplace related assessments, including return to work and workplace reports, is highly regarded
      • Experience in psychosocial risk assessment or workplace mental health programmes is highly regarded
      • Strong clinical judgement and communication skills
      • Comfortable working across individual care, organisational contexts, and stakeholder engagement
      • Experience supporting complex, high risk, or safety critical populations is advantageous

Benefits

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company - work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Flexible work arrangements - work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance - a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Mental health support - premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care

Job Title: Director, Labeling Strategy

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

The Role:

IQVIA is seeking a Director of Regulatory Labeling Strategy to support new programs to be based in the US. This role is intended for a forward looking, creative regulatory professional able to anticipate and address the challenges involved in swiftly delivering labeling for new products for global markets, including the United States, European Union, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. This is a 6 month contract with the potential for extension.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Global labeling experience to provide labeling strategy support across labeling for CCDS, US, EU, Rest of World (ROW), and other major markets.
  • Develop and maintain current knowledge of labeling regulations and industry standards for labeling and communicate requirements to stakeholders as needed.
  • Lead the Target Product Label (TPL) development for early-phase assets.
  • Develop labeling content, format and accountability for regulatory submissions (MAAs) and related supplements and amendments. Ensure that new labeling text meets regulatory labeling requirements.
  • Support the project teams with Rest of World ROW labeling assessments against the CCDS and preparation of Health Authority (HA) responses.
  • Interface with Project Teams to ensure consistency of labeling processes and local compliance with CCDS.
  • Effectively communicate the regulatory labeling strategy, risks, mitigation strategies and overall plans to the Global Regulatory Science Leadership Team, Project Development Teams and senior management, as relevant.
  • Provide input to the end-to-end labeling process.
  • Ability to lead and manage labeling team meetings, driving strategic discussions and managing content.
  • Provide coverage, as needed, on other products during peak periods or during absences of other team members.

SPECIFIC SKILLS

  • Experience facilitating meetings and driving consensus and results.
  • Excellent leadership, communication (verbal and written) and collaboration skills.
  • Proven ability in medical/technical writing.
  • Labeling experience (CCDS, US, EU, UK, other major markets) in rare diseases, oncology and/or vaccines is desirable.
  • Experience with TPL work for early development programs and identified life-cycle programs.
  • Sense of urgency regarding FDA/EMA/MHRA/other HA communications and response timelines to provide coverage for product approvals and labeling negotiations.
  • Integrity: overriding commitment to integrity and high standards for self and others.
  • Results orientation
  • Strategic orientation: ability to link company and departmental visions with daily work
  • Interacts effectively as member of the Regulatory sub-team, communicating effectively on strategies to the Global Labeling Committee and collaborating with business partners, including affiliates and third parties.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: ability to adapt to, and work effectively within, a variety of situations and with various individuals and groups.
  • Relationship building, teamwork and cooperation: builds and maintains strong working relationships with colleagues.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BA/BS degree in a scientific discipline required, Master’s or PhD preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry
  • 7+ years of experience in Regulatory labeling
  • Strong knowledge of current global regulations, including specifically: e.g. vaccine development regulations and registrations pathways.
  • Strong experience with CTD format and content regulatory filings
  • Exceptional written and oral communication
  • Experience dealing with broad range of stakeholders at all levels internal and external to the company
  • Delivery of labeling for at least one major application (NDA/BLA/MAA/JNDA, etc.)

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud.
