Position Title: J Street U Campus Fellowship

Reports To: J Street U Regional Coordinator

Location: All Universities with J Street U Chapters

Duration: 2026-2027 School Year

Looking to bring a pro-Israel, pro-Peace, pro-Democracy community to your campus? Apply to be a campus fellow today!

Program Description

J Street U is launching a paid fellowship program to establish and grow our presence on priority campuses nationwide. This fellowship serves as a catalyst for bringing J Street U to new campuses and to students who would benefit from being part of our community. Campus Fellows will receive $750 per semester to lead grassroots organizing efforts and establish J Street U programming on their campus. This role is designed for motivated students who can independently launch initiatives while working collaboratively with regional staff. Fellows will serve as the primary J Street U representative on campus, building community and connecting students to our broader movement.

About J Street

J Street is the political home for pro-Israel, pro-peace Americans working for the future of Israel as the democratic homeland of the Jewish people. The organization believes that preserving Israel’s Jewish and democratic character depends on achieving a two-state solution, resulting in a Palestinian state living alongside Israel in peace and security.

J Street focuses its work in three main areas: (1) Advocating and demonstrating support for pro-Israel, pro-peace policies in Congress, the media and the Jewish community; (2) Endorsing and raising money for federal candidates who share J Street’s agenda; and (3) Educating the public and raising awareness of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the two-state solution.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be an enrolled undergraduate student on a campus with no existing J Street U chapter or limited J Street U presence
  • Ineligible to apply for the Dounn Congressional Fellowship program during fellowship term

Time Commitment

  • 3-5 hours per week
  • Two semesters (full academic year commitment)

Responsibilities May Include:

  • Plan and execute 6 J Street U programs throughout the academic year (3 per semester)
  • Represent J Street U at campus orientation, information sessions, and activities fairs each semester to engage new students.
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with interested students to encourage deeper involvement
  • Develop and maintain relationships with campus Hillel and other relevant student organizations
  • Serve as primary campus liaison for J Street U activities and initiatives
  • Participate in bi-weekly check-in meetings with assigned regional coordinator
  • Attend monthly J Street U National calls

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Strong relational and interpersonal skills
  • Careful attention to detail
  • Interest in and/or knowledge of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict

Learn More about J Street’s Work

To Apply for the Position

We are excited to receive applications from a broad range of applicants as we grow our organization to better reflect the diversity of the communities that care about our mission. While we will prioritize applications from current J Street U students, all motivated pro-Israel pro-peace students are encouraged to apply. Applicants are considered on a rolling basis.

Please submit the items listed below:

  1. Cover letter that explains why you are interested in this unique experience
  2. Resume
  3. List of three references
  4. Answer the following prompt: In 300-500 words, what role do you think J Street U can play on your campus ?

At J Street we value an inclusive, welcoming, and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to understanding and valuing each other’s perspectives at all levels of the organization thereby creating a culture that allows us to better serve our employees, and the communities we work with. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law. This policy applies with regard to all aspects of one’s employment and fellowship, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits, and termination.

Admission decisions will be made on a rolling basis. We encourage applicants to submit their materials as early as possible to ensure ideal placement in a congressional office. Applicants who move on to further consideration may be contacted for a telephone interview after review of their application, and may need to submit additional materials.

Salary: $750 per semester

raw.description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity

About STERRY

At STERRY, we help ambitious brands scale through data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable results. Over the years, we've helped clients generate more than $100 million in trackable online revenue across crowdfunding, e-commerce, and growth-focused campaigns. We're currently supporting the growth of a logistics technology platform and are looking for a sharp, ambitious, and commercially minded Marketing Director to help scale the business globally.

The Role This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys owning both strategy and execution. As Marketing Director, you'll bridge the gap between B2B supply chain marketing and technology platform growth, building and optimizing the marketing engine that attracts, converts, and retains 3PL partners and platform users worldwide. Working directly with the CEO and collaborating with cross-functional teams, you'll be responsible for everything from high-level growth planning and market expansion initiatives to campaign execution, outreach strategy, funnel optimization, and performance analysis. We're looking for someone who understands the logistics landscape, knows how to market a B2B platform or marketplace, and enjoys rolling up their sleeves to make things happen.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Growth
  • Own and execute the company's global marketing strategy, including brand positioning, demand generation, content marketing, SEO, paid media, email marketing, and product marketing.
  • Develop and optimize inbound and outbound marketing funnels that drive qualified 3PL partnerships and platform sign-ups.
  • Build scalable lead generation systems and nurturing programs across email, LinkedIn, and other acquisition channels.
  • Develop compelling messaging and positioning that resonates with 3PL providers, e-commerce merchants, and supply chain stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with the CEO to align marketing initiatives with business objectives, market expansion plans, and strategic partnerships.
  • Continuously evaluate growth opportunities, customer acquisition strategies, and market trends to support business growth.
3PL Research, Outreach & Partnership Development
  • Identify, research, and evaluate potential 3PL partners across global markets based on capabilities, geographic coverage, and strategic fit.
  • Build and maintain a structured database of prospective partners, including service offerings, contact information, engagement history, and partnership status.
  • Execute outreach campaigns through email, LinkedIn, and other channels to introduce the platform and generate partnership opportunities.
  • Conduct initial qualification and discovery conversations to assess partnership potential and business fit.
  • Prepare prospect profiles, competitive analyses, service gap assessments, and recommended engagement strategies.
  • Manage ongoing follow-up and relationship-building efforts throughout the partnership pipeline.
  • Monitor and respond to inbound partnership inquiries, emails, and direct messages in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support and oversee social media activities related to partner engagement and brand visibility.
  • Manage and mentor team members and virtual assistants responsible for 3PL sourcing and outreach initiatives.
Analytics, Platform Performance & Market Intelligence
  • Monitor website traffic, user behavior, order flows, conversion rates, and user journeys to identify growth opportunities and areas for optimization.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators including MQLs, sign-ups, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and campaign performance.
  • Analyze acquisition channels, user engagement metrics, and conversion paths to improve platform performance.
  • Review order activity and operational trends, escalating issues and identifying opportunities for process improvements.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly reports highlighting growth performance, outreach effectiveness, partnership pipeline status, and strategic recommendations.
  • Conduct ongoing competitor analysis and monitor logistics industry trends, pricing changes, market developments, and emerging opportunities.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Lead and mentor a growing cross-functional team supporting marketing, outreach, research, design, development, and growth initiatives.
  • Directly oversee the 3PL Searching & Outreach team, ensuring sourcing pipelines, outreach efforts, and engagement targets are achieved.
  • Collaborate with design, development, operations, and data teams to improve customer experience and optimize growth initiatives.
  • Establish clear goals, reporting structures, workflows, and performance expectations across the team.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.
Executive Partnership & Operational Support
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO on growth initiatives, partnership development, and market expansion opportunities.
  • Coordinate projects across multiple stakeholders, ensuring priorities remain aligned and execution stays on track.
  • Conduct ad hoc market research, competitive analysis, and business intelligence projects to support strategic decision-making.
  • Assist with scheduling, communications, meeting preparation, and executive follow-ups related to key initiatives.
  • Support meeting documentation, action-item tracking, and project coordination.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and logistics for partnership meetings, conferences, and industry events when required.
Team Structure This role will directly lead and collaborate with:
  • 3PL Searching Lead
  • 3PL Searching Assistant
What We're Looking For:

Logistics & 3PL Industry Expertise You have hands-on experience within the logistics, freight forwarding, fulfillment, supply chain, shipping, or 3PL technology ecosystem. You understand how logistics providers operate, the challenges they face, and how purchasing and partnership decisions are made.

Strategic Yet Hands-On You can confidently move between quarterly growth planning and day-to-day execution. Whether it's refining a go-to-market strategy, reviewing campaign performance, writing outreach messaging, or optimizing conversion funnels, you're comfortable owning the details.

Data-Driven Decision Maker You don't just look at traffic reports—you understand user behavior, conversion paths, acquisition performance, and growth metrics. You know how to turn data into actionable recommendations and work effectively with developers and technical teams to improve outcomes.

Strong Communicator & Relationship Builder You can confidently present performance updates and market insights to executive leadership while maintaining clear communication with partners, prospects, and internal teams. You build trust quickly and represent the company professionally across global markets.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or Communications, or related field is a plus— but what truly matters is what you can build. A standout portfolio or equivalent hands-on experience is just as valued.
  • 6–8+ years of experience in marketing, growth, business development, partnerships, or related leadership roles.
  • Proven success within a 3PL, logistics, freight forwarding, B2B supply chain technology, marketplace, or related environment.
  • Strong understanding of both inbound and outbound lead generation strategies.
  • Experience designing and executing outreach and nurturing sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
  • Deep understanding of global logistics markets, industry dynamics, pricing structures, and competitive landscapes.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and driving business growth initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using modern marketing and analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Hotjar, CRM systems, automation tools, and reporting platforms.
  • Shopify and broader e-commerce ecosystem experience is highly preferred.
  • Strong project management, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and growth-oriented environment
Why Join STERRY?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in building and scaling a growing global platform while working directly with leadership. You'll have the autonomy to shape strategy, influence business decisions, build meaningful partnerships, and create measurable impact within an industry undergoing rapid transformation.

Ranked among the largest accounting and consulting firms in the country and consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work, Cherry Bekaert delivers innovative advisory, assurance and tax services to our clients. At Cherry Bekaert we create shared success through teamwork, energy, and expertise. We approach today’s toughest business challenges with a client-first mindset, working together to create exceptional value. We are all committed to making a difference for our people, our clients, our community, and our professions. To meet this commitment, Cherry Bekaert will provide you with the space to pursue growth and development opportunities that will guide and support you at each stage of your personal and professional journey.

As a result of continued growth, Cherry Bekaert’s Risk Advisory Services team is seeking an IT Senior Associate who is passionate about helping organizations navigate technology risk while enabling business growth. You will work with organizations to evaluate not only the effectiveness of their IT controls and risk management programs, but also the technology infrastructure that supports business operations and growth. Successful candidates understand how core infrastructure components, including networks, servers, cloud platforms, databases, identity and access management, and enterprise applications, scale alongside evolving business needs. Given the client-facing nature of this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your leadership capabilities while building trusted relationships with key decision makers as you deliver value across a broad scope of projects, including but not limited to:

  • IT Risk Assessment

  • IT General Controls (ITGCs)

  • Internal Audit

  • SOX Compliance

  • IT Governance

  • Cybersecurity Risk Management

  • Technology Infrastructure Review & Roadmapping

  • Control Design and Optimization

As an IT Risk Advisory Senior Associate, you will:

  • Execute IT internal audits and evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, application controls, and business process controls

  • Support SOX readiness and SOX 404 compliance initiatives, including access management, change management, computer operations, system development lifecycle controls, and risk and control matrices

  • Evaluate IT governance structures, policies, third-party risk practices, and controls using frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, and NIST

  • Assess cybersecurity governance and risks associated with cloud technologies, artificial intelligence, automation, business continuity, disaster recovery, and other emerging technologies

  • Strong analytical, communication, and report-writing skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a client-service environment

  • Ability to travel as need to support client engagements, not expected to exceed 25%

Additional, preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with SOX 404 compliance, IT risk assessments, internal audit, cybersecurity risk assessments, COSO, COBIT, or enterprise resource planning environments such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics

  • Experience evaluating IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, ERP environments, or technology-enabled business transformations, including considerations related to growth, system scalability, and organizational change

  • Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance platforms, data analytics, or automation tools

What you can expect from us:

  • Our shared values that foster inclusion and belonging including uncompromising integrity, collaboration, trust, and mutual respect

  • The opportunity to innovate and do work that motivates and engages you

  • A collaborative environment focused on enabling you to further your career growth and continuous professional development

  • Competitive compensation and a total rewards package that focuses on all aspects of your wellbeing

  • Flexibility to do impactful work and the time to enjoy your life outside of work

The salary range for this position is included below. Individual salaries within this range are determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education, knowledge, skills, and geographic location. raw.title: Product Manager, HealthTech
raw.excerpt: Who We Are We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine.
raw.description:
Who We Are

We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company that leverages innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability in elective medicine. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming our industry.

Adoreal is scaling rapidly, and the way we build is changing just as fast. We are moving from a world where product hands off specs and Figma files to engineering, to one where product and design build working software alongside engineering. This role is built for that future, but it starts, as great product work always has, with deep knowledge of the space and the customer.

While we are a remote-first company, we are currently only able to hire candidates located in the following U.S. states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, OK, OR, PA, RI, TX, UT, and WA. We hope to expand to additional states in the future.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a Product Manager who knows their space cold and is excited to build, not just specify. The foundation of this role is what it has always been: understanding the customer deeply, knowing the problems worth solving, and having the judgment to know what good looks like. On top of that foundation, you will be hands-on with the tools that are compressing the distance between an idea and working software, building alongside engineering rather than handing off to them.

This is a high-growth opportunity. We need someone who can drive impactful product work today and grow into a product leadership role as we scale.

Responsibilities

You will own the full arc of a product area: understanding the customer and the domain deeply, defining where we should go, and increasingly, helping build it.

  • Develop genuine, deep expertise in your space and your customers. The most valuable thing a PM brings is real understanding of the people who use our platform, the way they work, and the problems worth solving. We are automating the ceremony-heavy parts of the job specifically so you can spend more time here.
  • Translate that understanding into product direction: define, prioritize, and execute a roadmap that aligns with Adoreal's mission, and think big about what is now possible as build time compresses.
  • Build working software against our actual code base using AI development tools, alongside engineering. You will investigate feasibility yourself, understand what already exists in the platform, surface complexity early, and come to engineering with informed questions and functioning work rather than a spec to be interpreted. Depending on the work, that might be an early prototype, or it might be closer to production-ready. The point is that you are building, not just describing.
  • Partner closely with design from the start. Product and design work side by side. This is a collaboration, not a sequential handoff.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes these tools effective: clear product requirements, deep customer and platform knowledge, and the documentation that lets AI tools produce work that looks and behaves like Adoreal. The quality of what we build depends entirely on the quality of the thinking and context behind it.
  • Generate user stories and engineering-ready tickets from your research and your work, and collaborate with engineering through refinement, where they review, improve, and extend what you bring rather than building from scratch.
  • Use platform data and analytics to make informed decisions, identify friction in the experience, and make proactive, intelligent recommendations.
  • Decide when to build and when to integrate, balancing speed, complexity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Set a high standard for product excellence and help establish best practices across the team as our way of working evolves.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years in software product management, ideally including complex, high-trust, or regulated environments such as healthcare or fintech.
  • A demonstrated track record of understanding what customers actually want — you can point to specific times you talked to customers, synthesized what you heard, and changed the product because of it. Healthcare or clinical customers strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand intricate workflows and systems and translate them into product and technical requirements.
  • Genuine technical fluency. You do not need to have shipped production code, but you should be comfortable reading it, reasoning about how systems connect, working in tools like a code editor and terminal, and understanding the tradeoffs engineers care about.
  • Hands-on, specific experience with AI development tools or products used to build real solutions for customers or clients — not just experimentation. You should be able to name the tools you've used (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Replit Agent, Windsurf, or similar), describe what you built with them, and speak to the outcome for the customer.
  • A builder's instinct. You would rather show a working thing than describe a hypothetical one.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex requirements and foster collaboration across design, engineering, and the broader business.
  • Experience building infrastructure and integrations related to financial or payment processing systems.
  • An analytical, data-driven mindset, with comfort using analytics, experimentation, and KPIs to guide decisions.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change. Our tools, processes, and what is possible are all evolving quickly, and we are figuring a lot of it out as we go.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with operational or back-office systems and the workflows that run a business behind the scenes, the kind of platforms where data integrity, process automation, and connected systems really matter.
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment.
  • A track record of adopting emerging technology thoughtfully and bringing a team along with you.
  • Background in healthcare, wellness, aesthetics, or another vertical SaaS environment is a plus.
  • Experience implementing an ERP or business central experience is a plus.

Benefits

What We Offer

At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Performance-based bonuses and company equity opportunities
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible schedules
  • Collaborative and thriving team culture guided by Adoreal’s core values

Why Adoreal?

Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles:

On top of that foundation, you will be hands-on with the tools that are compressing the distance between an idea and working software, building alongside engineering rather than handing off to them.

This is a high-growth opportunity. We need someone who can drive impactful product work today and grow into a product leadership role as we scale.

raw.excerpt: About the EngagementAllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.
raw.description:
About the Engagement

AllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.

This is a high-priority, multi-resource engagement supporting complex Adobe implementations across enterprise environments. The initial engagement is expected to run for approximately six (6) months, with potential for extension and future project opportunities based on performance, business needs, and continued expansion of Adobe-related programs.

Resources will work as part of distributed delivery teams supporting architecture, implementation, integration, configuration, data, marketing technology, analytics, operations, and program delivery.

Because of the scale and pace of the program, candidates should be comfortable working within cross-functional teams, collaborating remotely, and contributing quickly within established project environments.

Due to the critical nature and urgency of this hire, we are unable to accommodate extended notice periods, such as 30 days.

If you are not immediately available or cannot start within a short timeframe, please let the recruiter know whether you would be able to engage on a part-time basis while completing your notice period. For example, you may be able to support 20 hours per week during morning hours until you are available to transition to full-time.

Please be as specific as possible about your availability so we can determine whether an interim arrangement may be feasible.

Position Overview

We are seeking a senior Adobe Enterprise Architect to define and lead the future-state architecture for complex enterprise Adobe Experience Cloud environments.

This individual will operate across multiple Adobe products and the client's broader enterprise ecosystem, determining how content, customer data, analytics, identity, personalization, journey orchestration, commerce, CRM, cloud platforms, and external systems should work together.

This is a broad, cross-platform architecture role. It is not focused on implementing one Adobe product and is not a platform-administration position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior architecture leader and trusted advisor for enterprise Adobe transformation initiatives.
  • Lead discovery with executive, business, marketing, product, data, security, and technology stakeholders.
  • Assess the current Adobe ecosystem, enterprise platforms, integrations, data architecture, operating model, and technical debt.
  • Define current-state, transition-state, future-state, and North Star architectures.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable enterprise technology strategies.
  • Define how content, data, identity, analytics, personalization, decisioning, and activation flow across platforms.
  • Design integration approaches between Adobe products and CRM, commerce, cloud, data warehouse, identity, consent, DAM, and activation platforms.
  • Establish architecture principles, technical guardrails, integration patterns, governance standards, and decision frameworks.
  • Develop phased transformation roadmaps, dependencies, sequencing, and investment priorities.
  • Lead architecture reviews and guide Solution Architects, Consultants, Engineers, Developers, Product Owners, and delivery teams.
  • Create and present architecture diagrams, roadmaps, decision documents, and executive recommendations.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex cross-platform architecture decisions.

Relevant Adobe Specialties

  • Adobe Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Adobe Experience Manager, DAM, Workfront, and content supply chains.
  • Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Journey Optimizer, Campaign, and Target.
  • Adobe Commerce, customer identity, governance, enterprise integrations, and APIs.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise architecture, solution architecture, digital transformation, martech, data, or enterprise technology consulting experience.
  • Significant experience leading enterprise-scale Adobe Experience Cloud transformations.
  • Broad architecture experience across at least three Adobe products or capabilities.
  • At least one official Adobe certification is required; the exact certification must be clearly listed on the resume.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise current-state, future-state, and transition-state architecture.
  • Experience creating multiyear Adobe platform or digital-transformation roadmaps.
  • Experience integrating Adobe products with enterprise data, CRM, identity, commerce, cloud, content, and activation platforms.
  • Experience advising Vice President, C-suite, or comparable executive stakeholders.
  • Strong executive presence, facilitation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to independently lead a complex engagement involving multiple products, teams, and business units.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multiple Adobe certifications or certification aligned with AEP, AEM, CJA, Analytics, AJO, Target, Workfront, Commerce, or another Experience Cloud product.
  • Experience across four or more Adobe Experience Cloud products.
  • Consulting, systems integration, or digital agency experience.
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with privacy, consent, security, identity, and data governance.

What Success Looks Like

  • Client leadership has a clear and achievable future-state Adobe architecture.
  • Adobe products operate as an integrated ecosystem rather than isolated tools.
  • Delivery teams have clear architectural direction and decision guardrails.
  • The client views this individual as a trusted strategic and technical advisor.

raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $87,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer content strategy and information architecture across the full content lifecycle, from planning and development through management, governance, and publishing.

  • Develop and maintain user personas, user stories, and journey maps for key audience segments, identifying content needs, gaps, and opportunities to inform strategy.

  • Build and maintain content taxonomies, metadata schemas, and information architecture models that support findability, reuse, and consistent navigation across websites and applications.

  • Define content structure and organization standards (e.g., page templates, content types, metadata tagging conventions) for content authors and editors to follow, coordinating with SEO on structural elements that support discoverability at the point of creation.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

  • Support development of journey maps tied to specific audience events or milestones to identify structural and content gaps.

  • Contribute content-structure findings and recommendations to required lifecycle and performance reporting.

  • Maintain awareness of accessibility requirements (Section 508, WCAG) as they inform content and navigation structure decisions.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Technical Communication, or UX Writing.

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in content strategy, information architecture, or UX-focused content work, ideally within a large public-facing website or application environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building taxonomies, sitemaps, content models, and/or metadata frameworks.

  • Experience developing personas, journey maps, and other user-research-informed strategy artifacts.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of content management systems and accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG).

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting a DoD, federal, or other large-scale government-facing digital program.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Optimal Workshop, Figma, or similar IA/UX research tools.

  • Background in editorial or content operations in addition to information architecture.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

raw.title: Commercial Lead, Brands & Retailers United States
raw.excerpt: About RegenifiedRegenified was founded in 2022 by the pioneers of regenerative agriculture.
raw.description:
About Regenified

Regenified was founded in 2022 by the pioneers of regenerative agriculture. Our founders are known and recognised as the leading figures and guardians for regenerative agriculture and its journey to mainstream agriculture.

Regenified’s purpose is to accelerate the adoption and impact of regenerative agriculture by translating data and intelligence into trusted, unified, and common enablers that power a regenerative economy. To date, our standards have been approved by the largest grocery chains in the world and we are actively verifying large acres of farmland producing cereals, beef, poultry, eggs and fresh produce.

The Role

We are seeking a Commercial Lead – Brands & Retail to drive growth across food, beverage, CPG, and retail partners. This is a senior, externally facing role responsible for originating, structuring, and closing strategic commercial partnerships across Regenified’s full service offering, including verification, procurement services, and certification.

This role is accountable for selling integrated and standalone solutions to both CPG brands and retail partners, helping them activate regenerative agriculture across their businesses, supplier networks, and product portfolios. You will work with partners to determine the right combination of verification, certified claims, and regenerative procurement pathways based on their business objectives, and sustainability commitments.

This is not a transactional sales role. You are a category builder and trusted advisor, supporting brands and retailers through the commercial and operational realities of regenerative sourcing. You will engage sustainability, procurement, innovation, and executive leadership teams to design partnerships that deliver measurable, verified impact while creating long-term commercial value.

Your mission is to grow Regenified’s brand and retail portfolio by converting interest into long-term, multi-service partnerships, while deepening and expanding existing relationships over time.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Revenue Growth Across Brands & Retail

    • Deliver revenue growth across CPG Brand & Retail partners by selling Regenified’s verification, procurement services, and certification.

    • Build and manage a high-quality enterprise pipeline, consistently converting inbound and outbound leads and opportunities into closed revenue that meets or exceeds annual targets.

  • Prospect, Pitch and Close Enterprise Partnerships

    • Identify, develop, and close new enterprise-level Brand and Retail partners, translating sustainability ambitions into contracted revenue.

    • Represent Regenified at brand- and retail-focused industry events, trade shows, and conferences to generate demand, pipeline, and business flow.

    • Clearly articulate Regenified’s end-to-end, value proposition, to a broad set of external stakeholders.

    • Lead the full commercial lifecycle, including executive-level pitching, solution design, proposal development, negotiation of all commercial terms, and contract execution.

    • Structure single-service and multi-service agreements that support scalability, multi-year commitments, and long-term revenue growth.

  • Drive Strategic Account Expansion (in partnership with Customer Success)

    • Grow revenue within existing accounts by expanding verification programs, procurement engagements, and certification adoption over time.

    • Maintain senior executive relationships and lead all commercial strategy, pricing, and negotiation for upsell and cross-sell opportunities, while Customer Success owns delivery, account health, and renewals.

  • Build Repeatable Commercial Infrastructure

    • Develop and contribute to sales playbooks, pricing frameworks, and commercial models that support predictable, repeatable revenue growth.

    • Ensure disciplined use of CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) to track pipeline health, deal velocity, close rates, and revenue performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven Enterprise Revenue Leadership

    • 7+ years of experience driving revenue in enterprise B2B sales, partnerships, or commercial leadership roles, with clear ownership of revenue targets and complex salescycles.

    • Demonstrated success closing and expanding multi-year, six- and seven-figure partnerships with CPG brands and/or retail partners.

  • End to End Deal Ownership

    • Deep experience owning the full commercial lifecycle, from prospecting and executive pitching through pricing strategy, negotiation, contract execution, and expansion.

    • Strong command of sales structuring across standalone and bundled service offerings, with the ability to design commercial models that scale over time.

  • Executive Presence & Market Credibility

    • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex value propositions to senior brand, retail, and sustainability leaders.

    • Confidence representing a company on stage, in executive boardrooms, and at industry events as a credible commercial and thought-leading partner.

  • Strategic & Challenger-Style Selling

    • Brings an insight-first, challenger mindset to enterprise selling — leading with perspective, not product. You can teach partners something new about regenerative sourcing, verification, risk, or market opportunity that reframes how they think about the problem.

    • Tailor messaging and solutions to different stakeholder priorities across sustainability, sourcing, commercial, and executive teams, aligning Regenified’s services to what matters most for each audience.

    • Comfortable taking control of the commercial process — guiding conversations, pushing back when needed, and driving toward clear decisions and outcomes in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

    • Able to sell into ambiguity by defining the problem to solve, not just responding to stated needs or RFPs.

  • Builder’s Mindset

    • Thrives in a fast-paced, early stage environment where processes, playbooks, and pricing models are still being built.

    • Comfortable creating structure where none exists and continuously improving how the organisation sells and scales.

  • Mission Alignment & Integrity

    • A deep interest in regenerative agriculture and the role of verification, certification, and procurement in driving systems change.

    • High integrity and comfort balancing commercial ambition with credibility, trust, and long-term partner success.

  • Operational & Commercial Rigor

    • Highly organised and data-driven, with strong pipeline management, forecasting, and KPI discipline.

    • Proficient in CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and comfortable using data to manage deal velocity and revenue performance.

  • Industry Fluency

    • Experience selling into food, beverage, agriculture, CPG, or retail sectors, particularly in sustainability, sourcing, or supply-chain-related offerings.

    • Familiarity with sustainability claims, certifications, or regenerative agriculture.

    • An existing network of potential customers with whom you have active relationships.

Success Measures

  • Revenue Performance: Consistent achievement (or outperformance) of annual revenue targets across CPG Brand and Retail partners — evidenced by sustained growth in contract value, verified acres, and adoption of verification, procurement services, and product certification within new and existing accounts.

  • Pipeline Health & Predictability: A robust, well-managed enterprise pipeline with clear sales progression, accurate forecasting, and strong conversion rates across all three services, enabled by disciplined use of CRM and commercial processes to track pipeline health, sales velocity, close rates, and revenue performance with accuracy and transparency.

  • Multi-Service Adoption: Measurable growth in the number and value of partners adopting multiple Regenified services, demonstrating effective solution selling and long-term partnership design.

  • Enterprise Deal Quality: Execution of well-structured, scalable, and renewable commercial agreements, including multi-year commitments and clear expansion pathways aligned with Regenified’s delivery capabilities.

Why You’ll Love it Here

  • Make a Difference: Your work will directly contribute to healing our landscapes and building a more resilient and equitable agricultural system.

  • Passionate Team: Work with a great, mission-driven team with shared, unwavering purpose and drive.

  • High-Impact Ownership: This is not a cog-in-a-wheel job. You will have a high degree of ownership and real scope for innovation.

  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive pay, unlimited PTO, and 100% premium coverage for medical/dental/vision (with partial coverage for dependants).

  • Career Growth: We invest in your professional development to help you grow with the company.

Marketing & Campaign Support

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Benefits

raw.description:
The DRG Coder is responsible for reviewing inpatient medical records and accurately assigning diagnosis and procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS to determine the appropriate Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) assignment.

This role ensures coding accuracy, reimbursement integrity, and compliance with federal and state regulations, payer guidelines, and internal policies. In an Independent Practice Association (IPA) and Management Services Organization (MSO) environment, the DRG Coder partners with utilization management, care management, finance, and provider network teams to support accurate payment, risk adjustment, quality reporting, and medical expense analysis.

What You'll Do

  • Review inpatient hospital records and assign accurate diagnosis and procedure codes
  • Determine the appropriate MS-DRG or APR-DRG assignment based on coding and clinical documentation
  • Conduct coding validation and auditing to ensure compliance with payer and regulatory requirements
  • Identify documentation gaps and communicate opportunities to providers, hospitals, and Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) teams
  • Analyze denials and underpayments related to coding and DRG assignment
  • Support retrospective and concurrent reviews of high-cost admissions and outlier cases
  • Collaborate with utilization management, case management, finance, and contracting teams to optimize reimbursement and cost containment
  • Assist with internal and external audits, including RAC, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial payer reviews
  • Provide education and mentoring to coding staff and other stakeholders
  • Monitor changes in coding guidelines, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements
  • Prepare reports and summaries related to coding accuracy, financial impact, and audit findings
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and company policies
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Health Information Management, Nursing, or related field
  • Have at least 5 years of inpatient coding experience
  • Have at least 2 years of advanced DRG validation, auditing, or hospital reimbursement experience
  • Certifications One or more of the following required: • CCS, RHIA, or RHIT from American Health Information Management Association • CIC from AAPC
  • Have advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, MS-DRG, and APR-DRG methodologies
  • Proficiency in coding software, electronic medical records, and Microsoft Office applications
You're great for the role if:
  • Experience working with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plans
  • Experience in a delegated IPA, MSO, or managed care environment
  • Have a strong understanding of Medicare reimbursement and payer audit processes
  • Ability to interpret complex clinical documentation
  • Knowledge of utilization management, case management, and managed care operations
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S. The home office is located at 600 City Parkway West 10th Floor, Orange, CA 92868.
  • This role is required to attend occasional in-person meetings with internal departments and external providers/hospitals, training, or audit purposes.
  • The national target pay range for this role is between $28.00 - $32.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.

All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Hello, Rev. Lim!

We were thrilled to learn that you completed the first phase of our Ministry Staff Discernment Process and have been accepted as a ministry candidate with Empowering Leaders!In Phase I, you completed the initial application and spiritual and personal evaluations, so now we move on to Phase II. Below is an outline of what you can expect over the next few weeks.

1. Phase II Application and References: This is simply a continuation of the initial Phase I application and includes additional questions that will give us a more in-depth look at your spiritual formation and character, ministry experience, gifts, and personal calling. You will also be asked to provide a minimum of five individuals we can contact as references; those who know you and your journey to this point. Once your application is submitted, we will contact your references and ask each of them to complete a confidential reference form. So please tell your references to expect a link to the form from Novo.

2. Assessment: To learn more about you, we will use additional tools to evaluate your personality, strengths, and (if married) marital well-being; all of which (when combined with the assessments in Phase I) are predictive of fit and success with Novo in ministry.

Note: We recognize the sensitive nature of the information you will be asked to share with us and make every effort to protect your privacy by maintaining strict controls over the use and storage of these documents.

3. Final Discernment: The final step in the Selection Process is to meet with the discernment team for a Day of Discernment (DoD). The DoD is a time set aside to look deeper into your personal gifting and potential fit as a Novo ministry staff member. The discernment team consists of experienced Novo staff trusted for their insight and ability to discern fit and readiness for ministry.

To begin Phase II, click on "Apply for this Job".Please be aware that you must complete the application in one sitting. The system will not allow you to save and complete your application at a later time. Same as last time, this is not a formal employment application; it's simply the system used to gather information.

If you need more details or have questions, please don't hesitate to contact us at .

CircusTrix dba

Sky Zone

Franchise Business Consultant

Full-time

Remote with travel

**Must reside in Maryland, New York, or New Jersey**

Department: Franchise

Reports to: VP of Franchise Operations

Travel: Up to 50%

FLSA: Exempt

WHO WE ARE:

At Sky Zone, our mission is to enrich lives through the power of boundless play – whether that’s on the trampoline court, behind the scenes, or at the corporate level. We believe play fuels confidence, connection, and joy, and we’re proud to create experiences that reflect that purpose in everything we do.

As the leader in active indoor entertainment, we host unforgettable birthdays, team events, and school parties across the country. Backed by our parent company, CircusTrix, and recognized as a top franchise and growth brand, we continue to raise the bar for innovation and impact in the industry.

Our culture is shaped by our core values: We Play Without Limits, Ignite Innovation, Grow Together, Fuel Joy, and Serve Big, Give Bigger. Whether in a park or a boardroom, these values guide how we lead, collaborate, and show up for each other and for the communities we serve.

WHO YOU ARE:

You are a collaborative business partner who thrives on helping independent owners succeed. With deep experience in franchise operations and financial management, you know how to balance brand standards with entrepreneurial spirit. You enjoy building trust, solving complex challenges, and uncovering new opportunities for growth. Above all, you see franchisees as partners and their success as the key to strengthening the entire Sky Zone brand.

HOW YOU BRING OUR MISSION TO LIFE:

You help empower franchisees by unlocking growth potential, strengthening operations, and creating guest experiences that fuel joy at every park. You achieve this by –

Franchisee Partnership & Engagement

  • Building and maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with franchise owners and their leadership teams.
  • Conducting needs assessments to understand franchisee challenges, opportunities, and long-term business goals.
  • Providing tailored recommendations and action plans that respect franchisee autonomy while reinforcing brand standards and proven systems.
  • Serving as a liaison between franchisees and the corporate support team, ensuring alignment, consistency, and two-way communication.

Strategic Planning & Growth

  • Guiding franchisees in developing and executing strategic business plans that support both local growth and overall brand performance.
  • Advising on market trends, expansion opportunities, and competitive positioning to drive profitability.
  • Partnering with owners to evaluate new revenue streams, from memberships and birthday parties to food & beverage programs and seasonal initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Brand Standards

  • Providing operational consulting to help franchisees adopt best practices and increase efficiency.
  • Monitoring compliance with brand standards, policies, and procedures, and coaching owners on maintaining consistency across all guest experiences.
  • Conducting business reviews and sharing benchmarking data to highlight performance trends and identify opportunities for improvement.

Training & Development

  • Delivering coaching and mentorship to franchisees and their management teams on leadership, operational, and financial skills.
  • Leading workshops and regional meetings that enhance franchisee knowledge in areas such as sales, marketing, guest experience, and team development.
  • Providing franchisees with tools and resources that make it easier to implement proven strategies and achieve sustained results.

Financial Guidance & Accountability

  • Analyzing financial statements (including P&Ls, sales metrics, and benchmarking reports) with franchisees to identify strengths and opportunities.
  • Supporting franchisees in setting budgets, managing costs, and reaching financial targets.
  • Partnering with owners to adopt company-wide initiatives and growth drivers while adapting them to local markets.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensuring franchisee operations comply with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
  • Advising on risk mitigation strategies and ensuring brand protection in all aspects of business operations.
  • Acting as a subject matter expert in park operations, financial acumen, and franchise system standards.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Extensive franchise leadership experiencewith 7+ years in franchise consulting, business development, or multi-unit operations.
  • Proven success in driving growth and strengthening franchise businesses.
  • Strong financial expertise with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency with business tools including CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Clear and compelling communication and presentation skills that inspire confidence, drive collaboration, and build strong relationships with diverse partners.
  • Creative problem-solving ability fueled by curiosity, resourcefulness, and a solutions-first mindset.
  • Adaptability and agility to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment while keeping both performance and guest joy at the center of decision-making.
  • Physical requirements include the ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working on a computer and communicating via phone and Teams, as well as the ability to move around during park visits, with or without reasonable accommodation.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

Franchisees are at the heart of Sky Zone’s growth and success, and their ability to thrive directly shapes the experiences we deliver to millions of guests. As a Franchise Business Consultant, you play a critical role in bridging the franchisor–franchisee relationship, ensuring that independent owners have the tools, strategies, and support they need to succeed. Through guiding franchisees toward stronger operations, smarter financial decisions, and consistent brand standards, you help fuel both their profitability and the joy our parks bring to every community we serve.

Compensation range is $100,000-$125,000 + bonus opportunitybased on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.

Application deadline: October 3, 2026

While we anticipate the application window will close on this date, Sky Zone reviews applications on a rolling basis and will consider candidates until the position is filled.

CircusTrix and its brands are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

raw.description:
POS-26210

The HubSpot Customer Success Strategy and Operations team is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.

In this role, you will combine deep data insights with business expertise to deliver comprehensive solutions that tackle critical challenges and enhance operational efficiency and strategic outcomes. You will work directly with global leaders across HubSpot to deeply understand business performance while driving growth and productivity through data-driven decisions and strategic insights. You will develop innovative go-to-market and operational strategies, including business/pricing model transformation, retention-driving plays, and supporting our annual Customer Success revenue plan.

Data Analysts act as the technical backbone of the operation, exercising a high degree of technical autonomy to navigate enterprise-scale environments. You will be responsible for architecting scalable, reproducible data assets that serve as the single source of truth for the organization.

In this role, while you operate with a high degree of autonomy - leveraging AI tools to elevate analytical standards and drive strategic impact - you’ll benefit from the support of the Operations Analytics community, sharing ideas, debating approaches, and receiving feedback.

We are looking for people who have:

  • Academic or professional experience with a heavy quantitative, analytical focus.
  • Track record as a go-to expert for the business, playing a pivotal role in driving data-driven decision-making and shaping strategic decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to build deep relationships and present strategies and outcomes to C-suite executives.
  • Passion for fostering a high-performing culture, participating in the analyst community and providing coaching and mentorship to junior analysts.
  • Experience working with large datasets, particularly regarding data mining, manipulation, and exploration in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using AI to elevate analytical standards and scale project execution without sacrificing rigor.
  • Ability to write performant, complex SQL queries and perform analysis in code-based or notebook environments to ensure workflows are reproducible and efficient.
  • Experience building commercial models (e.g., ROI, LTV) and forecasting trends to inform near-term operational decisions.

In this role, you will:

  • Be a driving influencer on the use and application of analysis; deliver what’s needed, and show what’s possible.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand your team’s data and business needs; become an expert in translating these needs into specific analyses with actionable insights.
  • Conduct quantitative analysis of user behavior to uncover issues or opportunities to improve our customers’ experience.
  • Collaborate across teams and business functions to infuse strategic, open ended research with quantitative insights.
  • Communicate insights to your stakeholders with a data-driven point of view and plan for action.
  • Navigate an enterprise-scale data environment and own the development of scalable assets that drive efficiency and data consistency.
  • Inform specific, near-term operational decisions and product roadmaps, leveraging reproducible analysis to ensure stakeholders act on high-integrity data.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$118,500—$189,600 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

Job Location: Virtual Argentina

Job Location Type: Remote

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Job Description

What Records Management Compliance Department does at Worldwide

TMF Operations handles the processing, maintenance and archiving of all essential documents in strict accordance with pertinent Standard Operating Procedures, country-specific regulations, and industry best practices. Throughout Worldwide Clinical Trials, our culture of collaboration and innovation is what propels us in our pursuit of excellence in clinical research and making a meaningful impact on every patient's life. Roles within our TMF Operations department have a global scope, with the opportunity to regularly collaborate with members of the Worldwide Project Team.

What you will do

  • Fulfil the "TMF Approver" and/or "TMF QC Reviewer" roles as defined by the relevant Standard Operation Procedure(s) (SOP) and working practices.

  • Process, review, and resolve rejected Trial Master File (TMF) documents, for complex studies or Sponsor portfolio of studies both in an electronic and hard copy format.

  • Prepare periodic TMF Quality Control checklists for review by Project Team review.

  • Perform periodic TMF Quality Control to ensure adherence to regulatory, ICH GCP, Sponsor, and industry best practices.

  • Work with a variety of Electronic Document Management and electronic TMF Systems to review, classify and process Essential Documents

What you will bring to the role

  • Possess data collection, indexing and editing skills, including ability to adhere to standardized document naming conventions

  • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly and concisely present information

  • Display strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline oriented, rapidly changing environment

  • Handle multiple, highly detailed tasks with exceptional accuracy. Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Develop proficiency in use of an electronic document repository or eTMF. General understanding of clinical research principles and processes

Your experience

  • University Degree preferred (Life Science desirable)

  • Up to 1-2 years of relevant TMF experience within the CRO/Pharma industry

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Clinical Operations Department does at Worldwide

Embark on a fulfilling Clinical Operations career as you leave a lasting impact on patients’ lives. Join Worldwide Clinical Trials for an unparalleled CRO experience, where you can drive extraordinary scientific breakthroughs and contribute to the very heart of every successful clinical trial.

Working alongside brilliant minds across a variety of therapeutic areas, you will have the chance to collaborate closely with top-tier colleagues from diverse backgrounds and specialties. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is cultivated in a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with our hands-on leadership and dedicated team members working together to innovate and solve complex challenges for our customers.

What you will do

  • Provide leadership and direction to clinical site management team members from study start through closure.

  • Oversee regional CTMs and coordinates efforts across the CTM team.

  • Represent Site Management issues at Sponsor, Investigator and Bid defense meetings and act as main point of contact for activities through the study.

  • Contributes to the overall project plan, by formulating a global monitoring strategy for site initiation, enrolment, site management and closeout phases across a given region and assigns sites on behalf of the sponsor.

  • When needed, assumes dual PM/CTM role.

  • Develop, maintain and ensure compliance with Clinical Monitoring Plans, including budgets, study tools and Site visit reports; perform regular review of protocol deviations, Out of Scope items and oversight of action items.

  • Training and management of CRA team on all clinical aspects of the study with support from Project Management, Medical Monitoring and Sponsor as needed.

  • Participate in the development of and implementation of recruitment strategy in countries and sites assigned.

  • Accountable for Forecasting of site visits w/CRA team to ensure staffing needs are met and any identified backlog is appropriately addressed

  • May act as a mentor for CTMs.

  • Performs Co-monitoring visits where required.

  • If needed, Review/finalize trip reports according to WCT SOPs, expectations and as outlined in the annotated report.

  • Supports the study team during inspections by healthcare authorities or sponsor audits.

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills in English and in local language.

  • Ability to lead and motivate a team remotely.

  • Demonstrate initiative and problem-solving skills by offering solutions when obstacles are identified.

  • Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally within a sponsor contact.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems.

Your experience

Working with large datasets and risk-monitoring tools, you will uncover emerging fraud trends, deliver valuable insights, and help protect the platform from financial losses, regulatory risks, and chargebacks.

As part of a dynamic and fast-paced environment, you will conduct detailed merchant reviews, oversee high-risk business sectors, and collaborate with stakeholders to strengthen fraud controls across the network. Working Hours: Monday to Friday (40 hours); flexible hours on a fully remote basis

  • Monitor transaction activity and fraud alerts to identify suspicious behaviour, emerging threats, and potential financial risks across our payment network.

  • Investigate customer complaints, regulatory notifications, and merchant-related risk concerns to support informed decision-making.
  • Manage card scheme fraud notifications, including Visa and Mastercard reports, ensuring timely and accurate case handling.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, pivot tables, and lookup functions, with strong proficiency in the Microsoft 365 suite.
  • Excellent English language skills, both verbal and written.
  • Strong communication and organisational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Applicant must have the right to live and work in Ireland.
