The Role:
11:11 is looking for a Network Operations Engineer whose primary responsibility will be to assist with providing 24/7 monitoring, technical support, implementation, and escalation for our global network infrastructure with a focus on 11:11 Systems Connectivity Solutions and Managed Network Solutions. We are looking for someone who is a team player, detail oriented, and has excellent customer service skills with a solid hands-on technical background as a Network Engineer in previous roles. Both written and verbal communication skills are critical to this role.
This is a full-time remote role, based in the United States, reporting to the Manager, Network Operations.

Responsibilities:
• Assist with the configuration, installation, maintenance, and upgrade of Fortinet, Cisco and Palo Alto next generation firewall devices supporting 11:11 customers and internal network infrastructure.
• Support existing customer facing networks and assist senior engineers with network expansion, hardware refresh, and connectivity solution efforts.
• Implement system and network configurations in compliance with corporate security policies and security best practices.
• Support technology solutions, such as SDWAN, MPLS, Wired and Wireless Connectivity solutions (Layer 2 and Layer 3), Firewalls, Routers, Switches, and Load Balancers in accordance with best practices and company policies.
• Perform day-to-day lifecycle management of Cradlepoint wireless edge devices via Ericsson NetCloud Manager (formerly NetCloud ECM), including device onboarding and provisioning, configuration group management, NetCloud OS firmware upgrades, and licensing/subscription tracking.
• Provide break/fix support and change management for Cradlepoint deployments, including troubleshooting cellular (LTE/5G) WAN connectivity and carrier-related issues, coordinating hardware RMAs, and implementing configuration changes through NetCloud Manager in accordance with established change control processes.
• Provide multi-layered technical support to our customer base using services supported through our Network Operations Center.
• Review and resolve anomalies that are potentially service impacting. Escalate to senior engineering resources or management if necessary.
• Escalate complex customer issues to senior engineering resources while maintaining ownership through resolution.
• Serve as a liaison with customers, vendors, and other third-party providers to troubleshoot issues.
• Accurately track issues in the ticketing system while providing timely updates to customers on progress and resolutions.
• Obtain and maintain technical certifications to further knowledge of products and services offered by the company.
• Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
• Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
• Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.

• Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or University degree in a related field of study or an equivalent 5+ years of related work experience required.
• Solid understanding of the OSI model with hands-on network troubleshooting experience using debug commands, packet captures, and routing and path analysis.
• Hands-on experience with configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco ASA/Firepower and Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center, Fortinet FortiGate Firewalls and Fortinet Product Suite including Fortinet Access-Points and Fortinet Switches.
• Experience with Cisco Routers and Switches; exposure to Cisco Nexus Switches preferred.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt Delve Deeper, we are a performance media agency specializing in the charity and nonprofit sector.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Delve Deeper, we are a performance media agency specializing in the charity and nonprofit sector. We partner with organizations that invest between $5 million and $20 million annually in media, helping mission-driven teams maximize their impact through advanced digital strategies that deliver measurable, scalable results.

Our capabilities span advanced reporting and analytics, intent-based audience segmentation, full-service digital media management, and personalized creative, providing our partners with a comprehensive, data-driven approach to growth.

Delve Deeper has been recognized as one of Built In Colorado’s “Best Places to Work” for five consecutive years, reflecting a culture that prioritizes both performance and people. We emphasize professional development and foster an environment where every team member can make a meaningful impact.

We are deeply committed to supporting our team members in their self-care, families, communities, and career growth. As a privately owned company, we move quickly, operate without unnecessary red tape, and create clear paths for advancement for those driven to succeed.

About The Giving Table

The Giving Table (TGT) brings together senior fundraising and marketing leaders from growth-minded nonprofits through thoughtfully curated peer groups. It offers C-suite leaders, Vice Presidents, and Directors a private space to bring their authentic selves to the table and openly discuss the personal and professional realities of nonprofit leadership.

Conversations may cover rising acquisition costs, board expectations, the impact of AI, donor lifetime value, attribution challenges, and the realities of leading through change. The topics vary, but the purpose remains the same: creating a trusted community where nonprofit leaders can learn from and support one another.

The Giving Table currently hosts gatherings in New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta.

About the Role

We are looking for a relationship builder who fills the room and understands that the best business development often begins with trust, hospitality, and meaningful conversation.

As Director of Membership, you will own the full membership journey for The Giving Table. You will strengthen our prospect list, connect with the right leaders, extend thoughtful invitations, and determine who will be the best fit for each peer group.

Once members join, you will continue building those relationships, gradually moving each person from an initial introduction toward a broader commercial conversation with Delve Deeper when the timing is right.

You may be a Business Development Representative with a hospitality background or an events leader who has always understood that the real work is building relationships and generating revenue. Either way, you know how to make senior leaders feel welcome while maintaining a clear focus on growth and results.

You will report to the leader of The Giving Table and work closely with Delve Deeper’s marketing and client services teams.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain a highly targeted prospect list of Chief Development Officers, Chief Marketing Officers, Vice Presidents of Fundraising, Vice Presidents of Marketing, and other senior leaders at midsize and large nonprofits across the United States.
  • Grow membership in The Giving Table’s current markets, including New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta.
  • Develop thoughtful, personalized outreach that reflects a genuine understanding of each prospect and their organization.
  • Leverage warm introductions, trusted industry relationships, and consistent follow-up to engage prospective members.
  • Curate peer groups of approximately seven to ten members, ensuring the right mix of organizations, cause areas, perspectives, and leadership experiences without placing direct competitors at the same table.
  • Own the member experience from initial invitation through attendance, including outreach, confirmations, restaurant selection, menu coordination, and other event logistics.
  • Attend select Giving Table dinners and events as a representative of Delve Deeper, strengthening relationships with members and ensuring a thoughtful, high-touch experience.
  • Work closely with our support team to manage invitations and RSVPs, keep prospect and member information current in HubSpot, and provide weekly pipeline reports.
  • Collaborate with internal hosts and facilitators to coordinate dinners, half-day sessions, off-sites, and salon-style conversations.
  • Work toward quarterly goals related to accepted members, event attendance, and membership growth.
  • Build referral networks by creating an experience members genuinely want to share with other leaders in their communities.
  • Develop relationships with the consultants, agencies, associations, and platform partners that serve the nonprofit fundraising community.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce engaged members to Delve Deeper’s client services team when the timing and need are right, without forcing the conversation.

Who You Are

  • You have at least three years of experience organizing high-touch development or relationship-building events for nonprofits, such as donor cultivation dinners, galas, advisory councils, major-gift roundtables, or capital campaign events. Comparable experience involving senior leaders in small, premium settings will also be considered.
  • You have existing relationships within the nonprofit sector, particularly with senior fundraising and marketing leaders, or you have successfully built a meaningful professional network from the ground up.
  • You understand the dual nature of this role. You care deeply about the quality of the experience, but you also recognize that the work must support measurable membership and commercial outcomes.
  • You bring strong business development instincts. You think in terms of pipelines, follow up consistently, and remain accountable to your goals.
  • You understand that the fortune is in the follow-up and know how to use HubSpot or a similar CRM to manage prospects, track activity, and maintain accurate reporting.
  • You are a thoughtful and persuasive written and verbal communicator who knows how to connect with a senior executive audience.
  • You are comfortable using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other prospecting tools to research and engage prospective members.
  • You stay informed about nonprofit fundraising and marketing trends and can confidently participate in conversations about topics such as iROI, donor lifetime value, CRM hygiene, acquisition costs, and attribution.
  • You exercise sound judgment and know how to build relationships without making interactions feel forced or transactional.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a nonprofit organization, ideally in development, fundraising, or marketing.
  • Experience hosting or supporting an executive peer group, mastermind, or invitation-only event series, such as YPO, Vistage, Chief, EO Forum, or a similar organization.
  • An established presence within professional fundraising communities such as AFP, NTEN, Bridge, Nonprofit Tech for Good, or Fundraising.AI.

Location

This is a fully remote, part-time position open to candidates located in the United States. Because The Giving Table currently operates in New York City, Washington, D.C., and Atlanta, preference will be given to candidates based in New York City or Washington, D.C.

Travel to select Giving Table dinners, events, and gatherings will be required.

Compensation

This part-time role offers an annual salary of $50,000–$70,000, plus a performance-based bonus tied to membership growth and downstream commercial outcomes. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and existing industry relationships.

Delve Deeper is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity enriches the workplace, and we are committed to growing our team with the most talented and passionate people from every community. Delve Deeper strives to create a culture of unity and respect. To that end, we have a zero-tolerance policy for behavior that promotes harassment, hate, or discrimination of any kind. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. If you require assistance during the application process due to a disability.

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000

Department Name:

Day

Job Category:

Information Technology

Banner Health was named to Fortune’s Most Innovative Companies in America 2025 list for the third consecutive year and named to Newsweek's list of Most Trustworthy Companies in America for the second year in a row. We’re proud to be recognized for our commitment to the latest health care advancements and excellent patient care.

The Kubernetes and Containerization team is part of Cloud Platform Engineering and is responsible for building and operating the container platform that Banner Health's application teams deploy onto. We design and automate the multi-account Amazon EKS environment, the Terraform modules that provision it, the GitHub Actions and GitOps pipelines that deliver to it, and the security, networking, and observability guardrails built into it. Our work allows engineering teams across Banner to deliver clinical, patient-facing, and business applications faster and more securely, and it serves as a foundation of Banner's enterprise migration from the data center to the cloud. Because our platform runs workloads subject to HIPAA and HITRUST requirements, security and reliability are central to everything the team builds.

Banner Health is currently seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to help build and support this platform. In this role you will write Terraform to extend our EKS modules, maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and ArgoCD, manage cluster and gateway upgrades, tune platform performance and cost, and onboard application teams onto the platform and its self-service capabilities. You will participate in design and architecture reviews, write runbooks and documentation, and partner regularly with security, networking, and application engineering teams. This is a fully remote position with a typical schedule of Monday-Friday, 8a-5p, and may include participation in an on-call rotation supporting the platform. An ideal candidate would have hands-on production Kubernetes experience, strong infrastructure-as-code skills in Terraform, scripting ability (Python, Go, or Bash), familiarity with AWS, and an automation-first mindset. Experience with Oracle Cloud (OCI/OKE) is a plus, as we plan to extend the platform to OCI in a future phase. This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is a highly experienced individual contributor in Development Operations. The position will lead a project team to perform the tasks necessary to analyze, design, configure, implement and support PaaS solutions, related services, processes, applications, and integrations.This will involve influencing IT functional areas, product owners and vendors to develop detailed design, execution and troubleshooting of strategic solutions in support of these systems. The position leads the efforts of resolving application and configuration issues/concerns, providing ongoing analysis of performance, implementation of approved changes, and ensuring continual service improvements. Will be responsible for Architect Cloud services that span storage, security, networking, and compute cloud capabilities. Responsible for all aspects of application production support, deployment and monitoring and develop tools to support these activities. Leads mission critical applications and associated platforms, ensuring the highest levels of availability, security, performance and stability are always maintained. Designs and builds tools and solutions with a strong bias towards automating as many aspects of support as possible to reduce or eliminate trivial support activities.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Anticipates internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve services, processes or products. Manages projects or programs. Recognized as an expert within the organization and within their field or function.

2. Solves unique and complex problems that have a broad impact on the business. Presents complex ideas, anticipates potential objectives and persuades others to adopt a different point of view.

3. Develops innovative services, technologies, processes or products that address current and future customer problems or needs. Interacts primarily with customers, peers, peers’ managers, patients and physicians across the organization.

4. Makes decisions with general functional, company and industry guidelines. May manage budget for large and/or complex projects or programs.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent working knowledge.

Must have in-depth knowledge of concepts within job function as would normally be obtained in eight to twelve years' work experience developing Enterprise Applications. Must possess strong knowledge of programming and cloud technology. Needs experience in medium scale project planning. Successful candidate will have skills to mentor less experienced team members. Requires strong communication and presentation skills to explain and resolve complex technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences. Requires ability to influence and interact across facilities and at various levels. As is typical in this industry, variable shifts and hours and carrying/responding to a pager may be required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Cloud platform Certifications: AZ-301, AZ-400, and AZ-500. Significant development and operations / engineering experience with the ability to apply that knowledge to solve complex problems. Three to four years' experience implementing Enterprise Cloud Solutions. Strong working knowledge of Java/C++/C#/.Net Core, hardware environment, and use of program logic.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

raw.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Hong Kong or Remote
Type: Full Time

The Role

As a ML Researcher at Nex, you will develop new machine learning models and algorithms that push the boundaries of computational perception and interaction on Nex Playground. You will join a small, deeply technical team that combines research and engineering to solve complex problems in sensing, understanding, and multimodal interaction.

The ML Research role emphasizes rapid experimentation, exploring new ideas and methods to expand what our platform can sense, understand, and respond to. You will work within the ML Research group, collaborating closely with ML Engineers who build the infrastructure that accelerates your research.

This role is ideal for researchers who want to see their work directly impact product capabilities while maintaining a focus on cutting-edge innovation.

The Mindset

You are driven by curiosity and technical discovery. You see research as a systematic process of exploration and validation, not just theoretical work. You balance scientific rigor with practical impact, knowing that the best research solves real problems. You thrive in a team that values experimentation velocity and measurable technical improvement.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop novel ML models and algorithms for computational perception and interaction
  • Design and execute rapid experiments to validate new ideas and methods
  • Explore advancements in computer vision, audio processing, sensor fusion, or related domains
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to integrate research outcomes into training pipelines and production systems
  • Measure and track experimentation velocity, the number and quality of validated experiments per quarter
  • Contribute to research planning and help define the technical roadmap alongside the Engineering Manager and Tech Lead
  • Document research findings and communicate technical progress to the broader team

Must Have

  • 2+ years of hands-on ML research experience in industry, academia, or research labs
  • Demonstrable track record of designing and conducting ML experiments from hypothesis to validation
  • Proficiency in Python for ML research and experimentation
  • Deep expertise with PyTorch or TensorFlow for model development
  • Experience training and evaluating ML models on real datasets
  • Understanding of model evaluation metrics, experimental design, and statistical validation
  • Familiarity with data preprocessing, augmentation, and management for ML workflows

raw.description:
Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (Early Career)

Location: Canada (Remote or Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Build technology that solves real business problems.

At Hiveway, we believe software should make work simpler—not more complicated.

We build payment and revenue automation solutions that help organizations modernize how they collect payments, connect business systems, and eliminate manual processes.

We're looking for curious, ambitious engineers at the beginning of their careers who want more than a traditional software development role.

If you're excited by solving real customer problems, building production software, and learning directly from experienced engineers while working with enterprise customers, we'd love to meet you.

What is a Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer?

A Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE) combines software engineering, solution architecture, and customer problem-solving into one role.

Instead of working only from a product backlog, you'll work alongside customers to understand how their business operates, identify technical challenges, and help build solutions that create measurable business impact.

You'll learn how software, payments, APIs, data, finance, and business operations come together to solve real-world problems.

No two projects are exactly the same—which means you'll constantly learn, grow, and be challenged.

What You'll Do

Working alongside experienced engineers and mentors, you'll help:

  • Build production software and customer solutions
  • Design and develop API integrations
  • Connect payment, CRM, ERP, and accounting systems
  • Automate manual business processes
  • Design data workflows and reconciliation logic
  • Investigate and resolve production issues
  • Participate in customer discovery sessions
  • Translate business challenges into technical solutions
  • Improve existing platform capabilities
  • Document and share technical best practices

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and directly with customers.

What You'll Learn

This role is designed to accelerate your career.

During your first year you'll gain experience in:

  • Software engineering best practices
  • Solution architecture
  • API design and integrations
  • Payment technologies
  • Cloud applications
  • Production operations
  • Customer discovery
  • Enterprise software implementation
  • Systems thinking
  • Technical communication

You'll receive mentorship while taking on meaningful responsibility from day one.

What We're Looking For

You don't need to know everything.

We're looking for people with strong fundamentals and an eagerness to learn.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Love solving difficult problems
  • Enjoy learning new technologies
  • Ask thoughtful questions
  • Communicate clearly
  • Take ownership of your work
  • Like understanding how businesses operate
  • Enjoy collaborating with both technical and non-technical people
  • Are curious about APIs, integrations, automation, or cloud software
  • Want to see your work used by real customers

Minimum Qualifications

We're interested in candidates who are completing or have recently completed a degree or diploma in areas such as:

  • Computer Science
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mathematics
  • Data Science
  • Information Systems
  • Physics
  • Mechatronics

Equivalent technical experience is also welcome.

You should also have:

  • Experience programming in at least one modern language
  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals
  • Familiarity with Git
  • Basic understanding of APIs, databases, or web applications
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills

Programming languages may include:

  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Python
  • Java
  • C#
  • Go
  • C++
  • Or another modern language

Bonus Points

We're especially interested if you've:

  • Completed internships or co-op placements
  • Built applications people actually use
  • Created personal or open-source projects
  • Participated in hackathons
  • Worked with APIs
  • Built full-stack applications
  • Worked at a startup
  • Automated repetitive work
  • Built something outside the classroom

We care much more about what you've built than where you've built it.

How We Work

At Hiveway we believe:

Start with the problem.

Understand the customer before designing the solution.

Build for production.

Reliable software beats clever software.

Stay curious.

The best engineers are always learning.

Own outcomes.

We take responsibility for solving problems—not just completing tasks.

Keep improving.

Every customer teaches us something that makes our platform better.

Your First 90 Days

You'll receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and regular feedback.

During your first three months you'll:

  • Learn Hiveway's platform and development environment
  • Shadow customer meetings
  • Contribute production code
  • Build your first integration or workflow
  • Participate in architecture discussions
  • Learn our engineering standards
  • Work with experienced engineers on customer implementations

As your confidence grows, so will your ownership.

What Success Looks Like

Successful engineers at Hiveway:

  • Ask great questions
  • Learn quickly
  • Build reliable software
  • Communicate effectively
  • Solve customer problems
  • Take ownership
  • Continuously improve
  • Help others succeed

Why Join Hiveway?

Large companies often give new graduates a very small piece of a very large system.

At Hiveway, you'll see the entire picture.

You'll learn directly from experienced engineers, work with enterprise customers, contribute to production systems, and influence how our platform evolves.

You'll gain experience across engineering, product, customer solutions, and business operations while helping solve meaningful problems for growing organizations.

If you want a role where your work matters from the beginning, Hiveway is the place to build your career.

Compensation & Benefits

Expected base salary:

CAD $85,000 – $105,000

Actual compensation will depend on your experience, internships, technical skills, and demonstrated capabilities.

Our total rewards package may include:

  • Performance-based incentives
  • Equity participation
  • Health and dental benefits
  • Paid vacation
  • Professional development budget
  • Home office and technology support
  • Mentorship and career development
  • Flexible remote/hybrid work

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume (PDF preferred)
  • GitHub, portfolio, or personal website (if available)

We don't expect you to know everything.

We're interested in what you've built, what you've learned, and how you approach solving difficult problems.

Equal Opportunity

Hiveway is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are evaluated based on their skills, potential, curiosity, and ability to contribute.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

If you're excited about building great software, solving real customer problems, and growing alongside an experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary: 80-110k

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue.
  • Spanish speaker required (verbal and written)
  • Must be located in Mexico

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity
  • Experience selling into Mexico or Latin America
  • Ability to think strategically and creatively in a new market
  • Excellent understanding of business acumen for emerging markets
  • Ability to manage logistics of selling into Mexico from North America

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
About the Engagement

AllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.

This is a high-priority, multi-resource engagement supporting complex Adobe implementations across enterprise environments. The initial engagement is expected to run for approximately six (6) months, with potential for extension and future project opportunities based on performance, business needs, and continued expansion of Adobe-related programs.

Resources will work as part of distributed delivery teams supporting architecture, implementation, integration, configuration, data, marketing technology, analytics, operations, and program delivery.

Because of the scale and pace of the program, candidates should be comfortable working within cross-functional teams, collaborating remotely, and contributing quickly within established project environments.

Due to the critical nature and urgency of this hire, we are unable to accommodate extended notice periods, such as 30 days.

If you are not immediately available or cannot start within a short timeframe, please let the recruiter know whether you would be able to engage on a part-time basis while completing your notice period. For example, you may be able to support 20 hours per week during morning hours until you are available to transition to full-time.

Please be as specific as possible about your availability so we can determine whether an interim arrangement may be feasible.

Position Overview

We are seeking a senior, hands-on CJA Product Modernization Consultant or Engineer to deliver a defined workstream within an enterprise Adobe Analytics-to-Customer Journey Analytics transformation.

Working with a Level 1 CJA Product Modernization Architect, this individual will translate modernization strategy into schemas, datasets, identity configurations, CJA connections, data views, metrics, reports, integrations, validation processes, and implementation deliverables.

This is not a general Adobe modernization role. Direct, hands-on CJA experience is required; Adobe Analytics experience without CJA implementation experience is not sufficient.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead detailed analytics requirements and process-discovery sessions.
  • Assess Adobe Analytics report suites, variables, classifications, metrics, segments, dashboards, and data collection.
  • Translate measurement requirements into detailed CJA and AEP designs.
  • Design or build XDM schemas and Experience Platform datasets.
  • Configure or support data ingestion, identity namespaces, identity stitching, CJA connections, and data views.
  • Build dimensions, metrics, filters, calculated metrics, attribution settings, and sessionization rules.
  • Build or migrate Analysis Workspace projects and reporting components.
  • Execute data reconciliation and validation across Adobe Analytics, AEP, source systems, and CJA.
  • Support parallel reporting, testing, defect resolution, cutover, and production readiness.
  • Document schemas, datasets, mappings, metrics, test plans, and deployment procedures.
  • Identify and escalate data-quality, identity, integration, performance, privacy, and governance concerns.
  • Support training, documentation, governance, and business adoption.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of digital analytics, analytics implementation, data engineering, Adobe consulting, martech, or related experience.
  • Direct, hands-on Adobe Customer Journey Analytics implementation experience.
  • Strong Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Platform experience.
  • Experience supporting or delivering an Adobe Analytics-to-CJA migration.
  • At least one official Adobe certification is required; the exact certification must be clearly listed on the resume.
  • Hands-on experience with several of the following: XDM schemas, datasets, ingestion, identity, CJA connections, data views, metrics, filters, calculated metrics, attribution, sessionization, Analysis Workspace, and validation.
  • Experience translating business measurement requirements into functional or technical solutions.
  • Experience with testing, validation, documentation, deployment, and production readiness.
  • Enterprise client-facing experience and the ability to independently lead a defined workstream.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Adobe certification related to CJA, Adobe Analytics, or Adobe Experience Platform.

· Multiple Adobe certifications.

  • Experience with Adobe Web SDK, Experience Platform Data Collection, tags, APIs, or Edge Network.
  • Experience combining digital and non-digital data for cross-channel reporting.
  • Experience with Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, or Target.
  • Consulting or systems integration experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned schemas, datasets, connections, data views, and reports are delivered correctly.
  • Legacy requirements are translated into an improved CJA model.
  • Data discrepancies are identified, documented, and resolved.
  • The workstream is validated, ready for cutover, and adopted by business users.

raw.excerpt: About Borrowell:At Borrowell, we’re on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money.
raw.description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we’re on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada’s most trusted providers based on each member’s credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you’re looking to join a company that’s transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell’s Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You’ll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure.
  • Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools).
  • End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives.
  • Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

Nice to Have

  • Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
  • Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
  • Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies.

Benefits

  • The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
  • Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
  • Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
  • WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
  • Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
  • Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
  • Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy

We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you’re unsure about your qualifications for this position we’d still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone’s had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What’s most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 – $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell’s full benefits package.

raw.description:
Data Governance and Data Analytics Presales Solution Architect

About Centrilogic

Centrilogic is a global provider of Cloud, Data, AI, and Managed Services. We help organizations modernize systems, build secure and scalable analytics architectures, and operationalize data platforms that deliver measurable business outcomes across the Microsoft ecosystem, including Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Purview, and AI-powered analytics.

Role Overview

The Data Presales Solution Architect is a senior client-facing role at the intersection of data strategy, analytics architecture, and consultative sales. This person serves as CentriLogic’s lead technical voice for data engagements, translating client challenges into practical, commercially viable solutions built on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Purview, Power BI, Copilot capabilities, and the broader Azure data platform.

You will lead presales engagements from discovery through proposal delivery in partnership with Account Executives, SMEs, and delivery teams. Work includes governance assessments, analytics modernization, platform consolidation, real-time intelligence, managed services positioning, and AI-readiness programs built on a governed and trusted data foundation.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on Microsoft data platform experience with strong consultative presales skills and executive presence. They can engage credibly with business and technical stakeholders, bring clarity to complex decisions, and apply AI acceleration responsibly with sound governance, validation, security, and engineering judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

Solution Architecture Development

  • Design end-to-end data platforms on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Lakeflow Connect, Spark, semantic models, and Real-Time Intelligence where needed.
  • Architect governance solutions with Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog, including cataloging, lineage, quality, classification, protection, and governed access across multi-source data estates.
  • Design scalable, auditable analytics environments using medallion architecture, Delta Lake principles, and Power BI/Fabric-native reporting patterns.
  • Define AI-readiness requirements and secure conversational access patterns for Copilot, data agents, and natural-language-to-SQL, DAX, and KQL experiences.
  • Size and scope engagements using structured discovery and ROM estimates and define delivery models spanning projects and ongoing managed services.

Technical Consultation

  • Act as a senior technical advisor to sales leadership, account teams, and clients throughout the sales cycle.
  • Engage executives and data leaders on strategy, governance maturity, analytics modernization, compliance, and roadmap priorities.
  • Lead discovery workshops, assessments, and maturity evaluations to identify gaps and shape solution direction.
  • Translate complex data, governance, and AI capabilities into business value, ROI narratives, and executive-ready presentations.
  • Maintain current expertise across Fabric, Azure Databricks, Purview, Unity Catalog, Power BI, Synapse, Copilot in Fabric, AI functions, and the evolving Microsoft data and AI roadmap.

Sales Support

  • Partner with Account Executives to advance opportunities with strong technical credibility and strategic recommendations.
  • Own the technical narrative in RFPs, proposals, competitive pursuits, executive briefings, and Statements of Work.
  • Develop estimates, pricing approaches, business cases, and tailored solution proposals.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and demonstrations that show measurable governance, analytics, and AI-augmented outcomes.
  • Help generate pipeline through industry presence, relationships, and trusted client engagement.

Collaboration with Subject Matter Experts

  • Partner with SMEs across Cloud, Security, AI, ERP, and Managed Services to shape holistic, feasible solutions.
  • Work with delivery teams to validate solution designs before submission and support project kick-off alignment.
  • Conduct peer reviews and due diligence to maintain scope integrity, delivery alignment, and proposal quality.
  • Contribute reusable assets, intellectual property, and internal enablement to strengthen the Data practice.

Qualifications

Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

Experience

  • 7+ years in data architecture, data engineering, analytics consulting, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years in presales, solution architecture, or a customer-facing advisory role.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data platforms with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, or comparable modern analytics platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog or equivalent governance tools for cataloging, metadata, lineage, and control frameworks.
  • Practical experience enabling semantic models, metadata, and governance for Copilot, natural-language query, and agentic access patterns.
  • Strong track record leading discovery, writing proposals, sizing engagements, delivering executive presentations, and advancing deals.

Certifications

Required (or to be achieved within 6 months of hire):

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203 or DP-700)

Preferred:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate (DP-750)
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance
  • Administrator Associate (SC-400)

Core Skills

Microsoft Fabric Platform

  • Strong Microsoft Fabric expertise across OneLake, workspaces, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Spark, Data Science, semantic models, capacity planning, and tenant governance.
  • Experience with Real-Time Intelligence, including Eventstream, KQL databases, and Reflex.
  • Practical use of Copilot in Fabric, developer productivity patterns, and conversational analytics through data agents and natural-language query experiences.

Azure Databricks Platform

  • Azure Databricks workspace architecture, including workspace organization, compute/serverless options, lakehouse design patterns, and integration with Azure data services.
  • Delta Lake, Apache Spark, SQL Warehouses, Lakeflow/Workflows, and notebooks for scalable batch, streaming, and transformation workloads.
  • Databricks and Microsoft Fabric interoperability, including OneLake/ADLS patterns, Power BI integration, and architecture trade-offs across Fabric and Databricks workloads.
  • Databricks support for AI-ready data architecture, including governed feature/data products, secure data access, and trusted datasets for downstream AI and GenAI use cases.

Data Governance

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Purview, including catalog, map, lineage, quality, policy, classification, sensitivity labeling, and governance operating models.
  • Unity Catalog: centralized governance across Azure Databricks workspaces, including catalog, schema, table, and volume-level access controls, lineage, discovery, row/column-level security patterns, and alignment with Microsoft Purview for cross-platform governance.
  • Experience governing Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, and Warehouse assets and applying compliance frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX, and HIPAA.
  • Understanding of how governance quality supports safe, reliable Copilot and agentic data experiences.

Analytics and Business Intelligence

  • Strong Power BI skills across semantic model design, DAX, dashboards, row-level security, Direct Lake, deployment pipelines, and governed self-service BI.
  • Experience preparing semantic models and metadata to improve Copilot, data agent relevance, trust, and accuracy.
  • Knowledge of data literacy enablement and migration paths from Azure Analysis Services to Fabric-based models.

Data Architecture and Engineering

  • Expertise in medallion architecture, Delta Lake, dimensional and relational modeling, and batch/streaming pipeline design with monitoring and error handling.
  • Experience with Azure services such as Data Factory, Azure SQL, Synapse, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search.
  • Ability to design descriptive schemas, metadata, scoped data products, and validation patterns that support accurate, production-ready natural-language access to governed data.

Presales and Client Engagement

Job Title: Legacy System Export Developer, PeopleSoft and Oracle EBSJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

CACI is seeking a Senior Consultant (Legacy System Export Developer for PeopleSoft and Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM) to support a large federal HCM modernization initiative. You will help migrate federal civilian employee records from legacy HR systems into Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple agencies. This is a remote role with limited travel and high impact on mission outcomes. You will own extraction, validation, and transformation of HR data; map legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader formats; and ensure all extracts meet EHRI standards and data quality thresholds needed for successful migration.

Responsibilities

  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL extraction programs to export employee data from PeopleSoft HRMS and Oracle EBS HCM databases, covering personal data, job history, compensation, benefits, positions, and organizational structures.

  • Analyze agency‑specific configurations and custom fields; produce comprehensive mapping from legacy schemas to Oracle Fusion HCM HDL file formats.

  • Build PeopleSoft Application Designer and Application Engine processes that deliver automated, repeatable extraction routines supporting iterative mock migrations and final cutover.

  • Develop Oracle EBS concurrent programs and extraction packages to ensure complete export of HR, payroll, and benefits data.

  • Create SQR reports and validation queries to verify extraction completeness, integrity, and EHRI compliance prior to ETL handoff.

  • Design and execute data profiling to identify data quality issues, orphaned records, incomplete fields, and customizations that require special treatment.

  • Maintain PeopleSoft and EBS legacy environments used for extraction development and testing, including schema refreshes, access management, and performance tuning for large‑volume exports.

  • Collaborate with agency legacy system administrators to understand custom configurations, interfaces, and dependencies that influence extraction scope and sequencing.

  • Develop reconciliation procedures comparing legacy record counts and key elements to extraction outputs to ensure zero data loss.

  • Document extraction procedures, mapping specifications, and known data quality issues per SAFe Agile artifact standards.

  • Support cutover activities during go‑live events, executing final extraction runs, validating outputs, and resolving extraction issues within tight windows.

  • Apply established methods and standards to independently resolve functional and technical issues of moderate scope; consult senior staff on complex or unfamiliar problems.

  • Communicate clearly with project team members and stakeholders to report progress, explain technical approaches, and support collaborative problem solving across Agile Release Train ceremonies.

Qualifications — Required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 5 or more years of experience in database development, data extraction, or database administration for enterprise HR systems.

  • 3 or more years of hands‑on experience with PeopleSoft HRMS (Application Designer, Application Engine, PeopleCode, SQR) and/or Oracle E‑Business Suite HCM (concurrent programs, PL/SQL packages, HR module tables).

  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL development skills; experience writing complex extraction queries against large HR databases with more than 100,000 records.

  • Experience mapping legacy HR schemas to target system formats for migration projects.

  • Knowledge of HR data domains including demographics, job history, position management, compensation, and benefits.

  • Experience with data validation, profiling, and data quality assessment.

  • Familiarity with Agile and SAFe methodologies and iterative migration approaches, including mock conversion cycles.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

Qualifications — Desired

  • 7 or more years of experience in legacy HR system data extraction and migration, with specific experience on federal HR system modernization projects.

  • PeopleSoft tools and technology expertise (PeopleTools 8.5x, Application Engine, Component Interface, Integration Broker).

  • Oracle DBA certification (Oracle Certified Professional).

  • Direct experience with EHRI data standards and federal personnel data reporting requirements.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Data Loader and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader file specifications.

  • Knowledge of federal HR data elements including Nature of Action codes, Standard Form 50 data, and position classification structures.

  • Experience delivering large‑scale migrations of 500,000 or more employee records across varied source systems.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in enterprise HCM or ERP environments.

Work Location and Travel

Primarily remote; up to 10 percent travel for agency‑by‑agency migration support during the contract period.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
