raw.description:
At Stitch, we’re building something extraordinary. As a fast-growing team of passionate marketing technologists, architects, and strategists, we bring together our diverse backgrounds and experiences to work towards one common goal: make marketers’ lives easier with Braze.

Customer engagement is becoming increasingly complex, but with the right technology, processes, and strategies in place, marketers can achieve great things. We're motivated to be drivers of what the future of martech looks like by building solutions that work.

We’re all in on Braze as the leading customer engagement platform and the cornerstone of the modern martech stack. As an Orbit-level certified Braze partner (the highest level of partnership), we work alongside marketers from some of the world’s most beloved brands to stitch together innovative solutions, better processes, and smarter strategies that make marketing magic happen in Braze.

About This Role

As an Executive Client Partner at Stitch, you’ll serve as one of the organization’s most senior commercial and people leaders, accountable for the performance and growth of an approximately $25M client portfolio. You’ll lead a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners who directly manage Stitch’s client relationships.

This role does not carry an individual Book of Business (BoB). Your impact comes from creating the structure, commercial discipline, executive connectivity, and team capability needed to deliver predictable growth across the portfolio. You’ll coach and hold your team accountable, maintain visibility across strategic accounts, serve as an executive sponsor, and step directly into client or commercial situations when senior leadership is needed.

You’ll collaborate closely with Delivery, Solutions, Sales, Strategy, and Marketing to protect client outcomes, shape growth strategies, commercialize new offerings, and strengthen Stitch’s capabilities. You’ll establish effective commercial rhythms, lead complex negotiations and escalations, and develop strong commercial operators and future leaders. Success requires someone who can be both strategic and hands-on—comfortable setting direction, creating structure, and helping a team translate plans into measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the overall commercial performance and profitable growth of an approximately $25M client portfolio managed through a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners.
  • Deliver disciplined account planning, pipeline development, and risk mitigation to ensure predictable, sustained portfolio growth and exceed Net Dollar Retention targets.
  • Lead or provide senior oversight for complex pricing, negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year programs, ensuring sound deal economics and appropriate risk protection.
  • Establish clear growth strategies and accountabilities across the portfolio, ensuring plans are translated into action and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain portfolio-level forecasting accuracy and pacing visibility, proactively identifying emerging risks, gaps, and growth opportunities to deliver commercial predictability.
  • Serve as executive sponsor across the portfolio, building trusted relationships with key senior stakeholders while enabling Client Partners to deepen and own their client relationships.
  • Lead or support transformation-level conversations that shape client strategy, demonstrate business value, influence long-term investment, and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic, commercial, or delivery challenges, intervening directly when leadership is needed to protect client trust and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Delivery leadership to ensure portfolio-wide financial health, staffing alignment, delivery quality, and shared accountability for client outcomes.
  • Bring the right leaders and capabilities into each account while remaining close enough to the work to provide meaningful direction and support—without displacing the ownership of the Client Partners on your team.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Strategy, and Marketing to shape go-to-market strategy, develop new offerings, and strengthen organizational capabilities.
  • Facilitate portfolio-level cohesion and communication, elevating emerging risks and opportunities to maintain a seamless, unified client experience.
  • Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of Client Partners and Senior Client Partners, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for client, commercial, and leadership outcomes.
  • Establish and reinforce effective commercial rhythms—including pipeline reviews, account planning, forecasting, and performance reviews—that create sustained growth momentum.
  • Develop and scale training, playbooks, tools, and AI-enabled ways of working that strengthen the Client Partner organization.
  • Create operating structure and clarity across a complex portfolio, particularly when priorities, client conditions, or organizational needs are changing.
  • Deliver clear, candid feedback in a way that reinforces accountability, trust, and team engagement.
  • Contribute to enterprise initiatives and leadership-level planning that advance Stitch’s commercial strategy, operating model, and long-term growth.

What Does Success Look Like in This Role?

  • You produce portfolio outcomes through the performance of your team—not through ownership of an individual BoB.
  • You maintain sufficient strategic and commercial visibility across the portfolio to identify risks, guide growth, and provide meaningful executive sponsorship while preserving clear account ownership within your team.
  • You elevate your team by developing strong commercial operators, strategic advisors, and future leaders.
  • The Client Partners and Senior Client Partners on your team operate with accountability and commercial discipline and consistently deliver strong growth outcomes.
  • You confidently lead executive-level client and internal conversations, create clarity around decisions, draw out the right perspectives, and ensure every discussion results in clear ownership and next steps.
  • You create clear growth strategies across the portfolio and ensure they are executed with focus, accountability, and measurable business impact.
  • Your portfolio reflects disciplined commercial leadership, including strong Net Dollar Retention, a healthy expansion pipeline, accurate forecasting, and informed decision-making.
  • You create structure in ambiguous situations and consistently translate strategic direction into coordinated team action.
  • Your team experiences you as both a high-standard leader and a trusted coach. You address performance issues directly while communicating in a way that builds capability, confidence, and engagement.
  • You move fluidly between coaching, executive sponsorship, commercial leadership, and direct intervention when circumstances require it.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For:

  • 15+ years of experience in commercial leadership, client strategy, martech consulting, or enterprise account management.
  • Demonstrated success leading and growing a large, complex client portfolio—ideally $20M+—with accountability for retention, expansion, profitability, forecasting, and the performance of other client leaders.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presence, and influence, with demonstrated ability to lead complex client conversations, navigate conflict, negotiate favorable commercial terms, and build alignment among senior stakeholders.
  • Proven success building, coaching, and holding high-performing client-facing teams accountable for commercial outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of financial metrics, deal economics, and the effective management of portfolio-level profitability.
  • Strong martech and customer-engagement credibility, with the ability to connect client strategy, data, technology, delivery, and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level growth strategies, solution recommendations, and business cases that influence client investment and expansion decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to create operating structure, make decisions, and mobilize teams through ambiguity, competing priorities, organizational change, and complex client environments.
  • A hands-on leadership style combined with the judgment to coach and enable account leaders rather than take over their responsibilities.
  • A leadership approach that combines candor and high standards with respect, self-awareness, and the ability to build trust across different working styles.
  • Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to a rapidly changing and growing market.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.
  • Eligibility to work in the United States without visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Stitch is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid bereavement leave
  • Mental well-being support
  • In-person onboarding experience during your first week at our HQ in Indianapolis, Indiana

raw.description:
Position: Multimedia Journalist Position Type: Full time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Location: London, ON (Remote)

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Working remotely in London with others in The London Free Press newsroom, you meet the twin demands of speed and quality as a multimedia journalist able to move up a fast learning curve. An enterprising self-starter and team player, you have a sense for stories that resonate with London’s diverse readership. The position requires working to tight deadlines, in clear, concise writing that engages readers, covering a wide range of news, entertainment and other subjects. Critical is the ability to use digital tools to break and develop stories, reflecting readers' real-time interests.

The position begins in September 2026.

What you’ll do:

  • Report and write stories – and be able to shoot photos for them – for digital and print audiences, and tailor content to meet those platforms’ varying needs.
  • Have and develop local story ideas daily, a job essential along with the flexibility to quickly pivot to other newsroom priorities to meet changing needs.
  • Use social media and other digital tools to find out what’s breaking and what Londoners in real time are talking about and which quickly needs our attention.
  • Cultivate sources to break stories and help set the news agenda.
  • File video clips for digital platforms; work with digital teams to create interactive content and other multimedia elements that both engage and enrich readers.

Who you are:

  • A journalism school graduate or candidate from a related field. Newsroom experience is an asset. You must be able to quickly layer and prioritize needs to move up a learning curve.
  • Flexible to write effectively in breaking news, features and short form, a job essential, along with non-traditional story formats such as explainers and Q/As.
  • Hungry to make the most of a chance to work in a daily newsroom with top-notch journalists and eager to show what you can do to help the room.
  • A digger, not satisfied with pat answers; always looking for hidden story angles and with a talent, or developing one, for explanatory journalism.
  • A reporter interested not just in what happened or is happening, but also why and how, with the ability to concisely convey that added meaning to readers.
  • Experience and strength in video or podcast presentation is an asset.
  • A valid driver’s licence and access to a personal vehicle are also assets.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Union Start Rate: $917.01/weekly

This is a unionized position subject to the terms and conditions of the collective agreement. The starting salary listed in this job posting is based on the Year 1 rate outlined in the collective agreement. Offers will be made based on the candidate's qualifications and experience

Applications:

Interested applicants should apply without delay, including a resume, covering letter explaining why the job should be for them and samples of their work.

We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.

raw.description:
About Yassir

Yassir is the Super App designed to make your life easier. Yassir’s Mission is to serve Africans in the continent and its diaspora while creating economic opportunities for service providers and infusing social values. We aspire towards providing our users with the most essential services to their door by leveraging technology and a large ecosystem of partners. We at Yassir stand for: Ambition, Transparency & Trust, Quality, Performance. And we are growing fast - super fast. By choosing a career at Yassir, you choose to be part of one of the most impactful, fastest-growing Tech companies in Africa.

About the Role

  • Yassir is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our Artificial Intelligence (AI) team and contribute to some of our key projects, such as Dynamic Pricing and Trip Dispatching. As a Data Scientist, you will play a crucial role in analyzing and modelling data to optimize our Machine Learning (ML) systems. Your expertise in both predictive modelling and software development will be essential in driving our solutions and providing value to Yassir. This is a very exciting opportunity, tackling some of Yassir’s most critical problems.

About the Team

  • The AI team is part of Yassir’s central Data & AI domain, which is responsible for all data related activities in the organization - from Data Engineering, Data Platform management and Data Analytics all the way to AI solutions and MLOps infrastructure development. We are a global team of Data and AI / ML experts, encompassing diverse backgrounds and skills. We strive to build state-of-the-art Data and ML infrastructure and solutions, and ultimately a Data Culture supported by responsible and democratized data access, data-driven decision making and automation. We push the envelope of what’s feasible, we challenge each other, we support each other, and we take great pride in our work. Most of all we are value-driven to create impact from our data solutions. If you have an inherent curiosity about the fields Data and AI, a relevant background and an internal zeal and drive to contribute, please come join us!

Key Responsibilities

  • Become an expert point of contact and thought leader on your scope by mastering the details and principles pertaining to it. We aim for this role to focus on optimization Pricing capabilities, such as Dynamic / Surge Pricing, Discounts / Commissioning Optimization and Personalized Pricing
  • Identify and propose ML opportunities related to your scope and beyond
  • Support with requirements definition and prioritization of ML projects
  • Collaborate with cross-functional Engineering and Product teams
  • Champion Data Quality as a critical input component to all ML solutions and Analytics
  • Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis and subsequent Feature Selection / Engineering
  • Utilize Statistical and ML techniques, as appropriate, for model training
  • Validate and tune ML models
  • Visualize analysis / modelling results focusing on meaningful, actionable metrics and insights
  • Deploy and test ML applications using our MLOps infrastructure
  • Monitor ML models on their technical performance, business impact and underlying data / concept drift
  • Explain technical solutions in a business-friendly manner, supporting Product teams in their communications and reporting
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation of delivered solutions
  • Support the Data & AI domain in developing its technical capabilities, improving its ways of working and collaboration with other dependent teams
  • Champion Data Culture, proactively share knowledge across teams, and participate and drive team building activities

Key Requirements

  • Solid Mathematical / Statistical / Machine Learning as well as Software Development technical skills - supported by a Masters degree or above in a relevant quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Operational Research, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics
  • Comfortable in efficient, production quality Python and SQL coding at a professional setting with at least 2 years of industry experience
  • Comfortable with key software engineering concepts, such as code / memory profiling, code optimization, scalability, code / QA testing, cost optimization and associated best practices.
  • Prior experience with Pricing / Economics related problems and/or modelling techniques - we welcome Economics / Econometrics backgrounds and experience
  • Comfortable with key Statistical concepts, such as statistical testing and causal analysis
  • Analytical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Engineering mindset focused towards delivering robust applied data science solutions
  • Visualization skills, including experience with common Python ecosystem libraries and/or Analytics / BI tooling

raw.description:
About Acceleration Academies

At Acceleration Academies, we believe in transforming the lives of students who have disengaged from traditional schooling to achieve their high school diploma through personalized, flexible learning and innovative educational practices, we empower young adults to earn their high school diploma tuition-free. Partnering with school districts nationwide, our dropout recovery and student re-engagement programs are supported by cutting-edge technology and a commitment to compassionate, impactful teaching.

Enrollment Counselors

Remote • Nationwide

Now Hiring Enrollment Counselors across the US

We are hiring Enrollment Counselors to support student enrollment growth across our academy network. If you have experience in consultative sales, call center or telemarketing environments, admissions, or student services, we want to hear from you.

While a position may not be available at this time, we actively recruit on an ongoing basis. When an opening arises that matches your experience and location, our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to connect.

When you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch about current and upcoming openings. Enrollment Counselor positions are fully remote; candidates must reside in a state where Acceleration Academies is authorized to hire.

The Role

As an Enrollment Counselor, you will play a critical role in helping students begin their journey to graduation. Working remotely as part of our Marketing and Enrollment Team, you will guide prospective students and their guardians through the enrollment process with empathy, clarity, and efficiency. This full-time position is instrumental in helping Acceleration Academies achieve student enrollment growth objectives nationwide.

Key Responsibilities

Enrollment

  • Engage prospective students and families through inbound and outbound outreach, including leads generated through district partnerships and marketing channels
  • Apply a consultative, student-centered approach to understand student goals, address barriers, and support successful enrollment
  • Own the full enrollment funnel, managing prospective students from initial inquiry through their first day
  • Guide students through application steps, answering questions and providing clear direction at each stage
  • Clearly explain school structure, program requirements, pacing expectations, and student responsibilities
  • Partner with Document Processors to collect and verify required enrollment documentation
  • Maintain accurate, real-time records of all outreach and interactions within CRM systems
  • Consistently meet or exceed assigned enrollment goals and performance metrics

Lead Nurture and Engagement

  • Proactively follow up with prospective students to maintain momentum and meet enrollment deadlines
  • Identify and address barriers to enrollment by connecting students with appropriate solutions and resources
  • Motivate students who may lack confidence or have had challenging prior educational experiences
  • Hold supportive, honest conversations about life circumstances and the value of re-engaging with education
  • Collaborate with Document Processors, Registrars, and Academy Directors to ensure a seamless transition to the first day of school
  • Demonstrate strong time management and maintain an organized, well-prioritized pipeline

Advocacy

  • Represent Acceleration Academies with professionalism and enthusiasm in every student and guardian interaction
  • Promote the value of our mission and dropout prevention model to students and families
  • Support broader enrollment team objectives by taking on additional duties as needed

Performance Metrics

  • Lead-to-enrollment conversion rate
  • Lead response time (SLA adherence)
  • Total new enrollments per month
  • Daily task completion and adherence to contact strategies
  • Application completion rates
  • Student show/start rate

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Communications, Sales, or a related field preferred
  • Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in telemarketing, call centers, or similar enrollment roles; consultative sales experience preferred
  • Skills: Strong communication, relationship-building, organization, and time management skills
  • Passion: A genuine commitment to supporting students who have disengaged from traditional schooling and a drive to help them succeed
  • Technology: Experience with CRM or telemarketing software (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Five9, RingCentral) preferred
  • Compliance: Must pass state and federal background checks
  • Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual, Spanish preferred
  • Experience in education, student services, teaching, counseling, or youth engagement
  • Familiarity with enrollment software and high-volume calling environments
  • Persistence and follow-up discipline
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
  • Passion for working with opportunity youth or non-traditional learners

Why Join Us?

Being part of Acceleration Academies means joining a team dedicated to transforming student outcomes. Here, you'll directly impact students' lives, championing their growth, resilience, and path to graduation.

We Value Our Team's Well-being

  • Compensation: up to $21.63 per hour
  • Eligible for individual monthly performance-based bonuses tied to enrollment goals
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with up to a 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, Company Paid Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Wellness Support: Employer-paid financial wellness programs and access to mental health resources
  • Employee Referral Incentives
  • Professional Development: Certification reimbursement programs

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and shaping the future of education, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in redefining what's possible for students everywhere.

Third-Party Agency & Recruiter Notice for Acceleration Academies

Agencies presenting candidates must have an active, nonexpired Master Services Agreement and be formally engaged by an Acceleration Academies Recruiter. Resumes submitted outside these terms will be considered the property of Acceleration Academies.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Acceleration Academies is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All roles at Acceleration Academies include core responsibilities that are fundamental to student success and overall academy operations. Applicants should carefully review the job description to ensure they can meet these requirements. Essential duties typically include:

• Consistent, reliable attendance during scheduled work hours

• Management of assigned workload and productivity expectations

• Ability to perform job functions in a remote work environment with reliable internet connectivity

If you believe you may need a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of the role, Acceleration Academies will engage in an interactive process in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Please note that accommodations cannot remove essential job functions or fundamentally alter the nature of the role.

Description

We’re on the hunt for an experienced, hands-on Head of Development to lead Tebex through its next stage of technical growth.

As our Development Guildmaster, you’ll bridge high-level technical vision with day-to-day execution, helping our teams stay nimble, focused, and aligned as Tebex continues to scale. Reporting to the Head of Technology, you’ll lead 15–20 developers through five direct-report lead developers and shape how our teams build, collaborate, and deliver world-class solutions.

Following rapid growth in both headcount and platform scale, this role is key to modernizing Tebex’s platform while preserving the high-velocity startup DNA that got us here. It’s a chance to help shape robust, secure, and scalable technology for the thousands of game studios and in-game creators we power.

AI is already a meaningful part of how our teams work, and we’re looking for a leader who can help take that journey further. You’ll mentor teams on AI-enabled workflows, optimize tooling across the development cycle, and make sure AI remains a practical multiplier for our developers.

Our core platform currently leverages PHP/Laravel and Vue.js, but we believe in using the best tool for the job. You’ll help execute a Node.js pilot program, evaluating how an expanded toolkit can improve technical performance, future-proof hiring, and give our teams a more flexible, modern engineering ecosystem.

So if you’re a technical leader who can balance complex architectural puzzles with people-focused leadership, unblock teams without micromanaging, and guide a major platform evolution without losing momentum – come join the guild.

This role is remote, but you’ll need to be based in the UK and eligible to work full-time.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and manage a department of 15–20 developers across four teams, mentoring team leads and fostering a culture of high performance and no-nonsense startup agility.
  • Drive the technical roadmap forward, overseeing the Node.js pilot program and leading the execution of our platform re-architecture.
  • Own project coordination for the development teams, proactively removing administrative bottlenecks to maximize focus and flow.
  • Lead the next stage of our AI-first development journey by ensuring AI tools are thoughtfully embedded in our workflow and coaching teams to identify AI-driven efficiencies across the development process.
  • Take full accountability for the development department’s output, ensuring that the product roadmap is delivered on time and that all code meets our high standards for stability, security, and performance before it reaches production.
  • Act as the primary coordinator during urgent technical issues and high-stakes deployments, unifying teams to drive decisive resolutions and clear communication across the business.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, such as Head of Development, Engineering Manager, or similar.
  • Proven track record of managing 15–20+ developers and QA engineers, directly or indirectly.
  • Deep hands-on experience with PHP/Laravel to guide our foundation, and Node.js/TypeScript to lead our evolution.
  • Previous involvement in a successful platform transition, whether a language pivot, framework migration, or shift to modular architecture.
  • Strong ability to maintain business continuity during major technical transitions.
  • Deep understanding of AI-driven workflows and experience mentoring teams to integrate these tools into every stage of the development process.
  • Expert-level ability to manage the logistics of software delivery, including identifying project dependencies, removing administrative bottlenecks, and protecting developer flow.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to lead change, mentor veteran developers through technical shifts, and navigate stakeholder expectations with transparency and directness.
  • Based in the UK and eligible to work full-time.

Bonus Points

  • Ability to rally the guild, tame legacy beasts, and keep creator commerce flowing before the final boss deploys to production.

﻿What you’ll get:

  • Remote Work: Work from home or anywhere that works for you
  • Private Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for your peace of mind
  • Stock Options: Be part of our shared success
  • Wellness Reimbursement: Support for mental health therapy, fitness activities, classes, and related equipment
  • Gaming Allowance: A dedicated budget for games and gaming equipment
  • Vacation & Holidays: 33 paid days off per year (including UK bank holidays)
  • Annual Compensation Review: Ensuring your package remains competitive and rewarding
  • Personal Development Budget: For courses, training, and professional growth

Established in 2017, J29 prides itself on its employee centric culture and high employee retention rates that allow us to ensure that we are creating a working environment that prioritizes the employee experience. Overview
Performs medical record and claims review for Medicare, Medicaid, and/or other claims data in order to ensure that proper guidelines have been followed and assesses for potential overpayment, fraud, waste, and abuse with regards to Medicare, Medicaid, and/or other claims.

Role & Responsibilities
  • Facilitates and manages assigned projects and contracts relating to pharmacy services. Leads and provides oversight to assigned tasks and contracts, making sure that contract specifications are understood, tasks are assigned appropriately, and information is available and circulated.
  • Prioritizes and accomplishes tasks and programs independently and in a team to ensure successful implementation of goals and objectives.
  • Works with the appropriate stakeholders to build partnerships, support data sharing, and develop tools and references to support changes in care practices in the pharmacy arena.
  • Reviews and interprets contract deliverables to ensure timely and accurate completion.
  • Contributes to the conceptual design and implementation of projects, as well as assists with project execution as needed.
  • Ensures all project deliverables and timelines are met and reports on variances in a timely manner.
  • Testifies at various legal proceedings or administrative hearings, when subpoenaed.
  • Provides educational programs, as necessary, to meet project goals. Contributes professional presentations at pharmacy, medical, and quality organization meetings.

Experience / Expertise
  • Requires 5-7 years work experience (this could be a combination of clinical and utilization review, case management, etc.) 8-11 years preferred.
  • Must hold a current, active RN license issued by the state board of nursing. Compliance with all regulatory standards and ability to maintain licensure throughout employment is required.
  • BSN degree is strongly preferred to ensure advanced clinical knowledge and leadership skills. Candidates with an Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) will be considered if they demonstrate equivalent experience and commitment to continuing education.
  • Coding certification preferred
  • Demonstrates strong analytical skills and the ability to make sound, timely decisions.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within diverse teams and foster a cooperative environment.
  • Embraces continuous learning, adaptability, and supports the development of self and others.
  • Skilled in planning, organizing, and delivering results while ensuring quality and support throughout processes.
  • Proficient in using digital tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and communication.

General Physical Requirements: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

raw.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.

As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.

Your role at Aircall

  • Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product
  • Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data
  • Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance
  • Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems
  • Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients
  • Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring
  • Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback.

Our tech. stack:

  • AWS (Kinesis,Kafka, s3, DMS, Glue, EMR, EKS, Redshift, Spectrum), Apache Pinot, Apache Flink and Airflow.
  • A continuous deployment process based on GitLab

A little more about you:

  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics).
  • 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics
  • 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript
  • Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline
  • Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift
  • Experience of query optimisation
  • Experience of kafka is a plus
  • Shipping and maintaining code in production
  • You like sharing your ideas, and you're open-minded

Why join us?

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in term of growth and opportunities
💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
💶 Competitive salary package & benefits (health coverage, lunch, commute, sports)
DE&I Statement:
At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion, irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations, are core to our Aircall journey.
We promote active inclusion to foster a strong sense of belonging which is one of our main strengths as a business. We strive to assemble diverse people that can enrich and learn from each other. We pledge to make sure everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued at the table -- providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open because we realize that we have work to do and much to learn.

raw.title: Adobe Solution Architect (100% Remote)
raw.excerpt: About the EngagementAllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.
raw.description:
About the Engagement

AllShore Talent is supporting a large Adobe implementation initiative requiring experienced professionals across Content Supply Chain, Experience Platform & Digital Marketing, and Program & Delivery workstreams.

This is a high-priority, multi-resource engagement supporting complex Adobe implementations across enterprise environments. The initial engagement is expected to run for approximately six (6) months, with potential for extension and future project opportunities based on performance, business needs, and continued expansion of Adobe-related programs.

Resources will work as part of distributed delivery teams supporting architecture, implementation, integration, configuration, data, marketing technology, analytics, operations, and program delivery.

Because of the scale and pace of the program, candidates should be comfortable working within cross-functional teams, collaborating remotely, and contributing quickly within established project environments.

Due to the critical nature and urgency of this hire, we are unable to accommodate extended notice periods, such as 30 days.

If you are not immediately available or cannot start within a short timeframe, please let the recruiter know whether you would be able to engage on a part-time basis while completing your notice period. For example, you may be able to support 20 hours per week during morning hours until you are available to transition to full-time.

Please be as specific as possible about your availability so we can determine whether an interim arrangement may be feasible.

Position Overview

We are seeking a senior, hands-on Adobe Solution Architect to lead a defined product, integration, data, content, or experience workstream within a complex Adobe Experience Cloud program.

Working with a Level 1 Enterprise Architect, this individual will translate enterprise architecture and business requirements into detailed product-level designs, technical requirements, configurations, integrations, and implementation plans.

This is not a general Adobe modernization role. Direct, hands-on CJA experience is required; Adobe Analytics experience without CJA implementation experience is not sufficient.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead product-level requirements, process-discovery, and technical-design sessions.
  • Translate enterprise architecture into detailed solution designs and technical requirements.
  • Own the architecture and delivery of an assigned Adobe product, integration, data, or experience workstream.
  • Design product configurations, data flows, APIs, integrations, security requirements, and technical dependencies.
  • Create solution diagrams, interface specifications, data mappings, and implementation documentation.
  • Partner with the Enterprise Architect to maintain alignment with the broader future-state architecture.
  • Guide Developers, Engineers, Administrators, Analysts, and QA resources through implementation.
  • Support configuration, development, integration, migration, testing, validation, deployment, and go-live.
  • Identify and escalate technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, and enterprise-level decisions.
  • Communicate progress, risks, recommendations, and decisions to client and program leadership.

Relevant Adobe Specialties

  • AEP and data architecture; AEM and content supply chains.
  • AJO, Campaign, Target, Real-Time CDP, and customer identity.
  • Workfront, Commerce, Adobe integrations, APIs, and supporting cloud/data engineering.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of solution architecture, Adobe consulting, martech, software engineering, data engineering, or digital-platform experience.
  • Recent hands-on experience architecting or implementing one or more Adobe Experience Cloud products.
  • At least one official Adobe certification is required; the exact certification must be clearly listed on the resume.
  • Deep experience with at least one Adobe product and working knowledge of at least one adjacent Adobe capability.
  • Experience independently leading a defined product or technical workstream.
  • Experience with integrations, APIs, data flows, migrations, configurations, or enterprise implementations.
  • Experience producing solution diagrams, technical documentation, process flows, or data mappings.
  • Enterprise client-facing consulting experience and strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multiple Adobe certifications and experience across multiple Experience Cloud products.
  • Consulting, systems integration, or digital agency experience.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, data warehouses, CRM, commerce, or identity systems.
  • Experience leading technical teams through testing, deployment, and go-live.

What Success Looks Like

  • The assigned workstream has a detailed, executable solution design.
  • Product decisions align with the enterprise architecture.
  • Developers and Engineers receive clear requirements and technical direction.
  • The workstream is implemented, tested, and deployed successfully.
